title: DSP Director
description:
The DSP Director is the executive owner of the Amazon DSP function, responsible for portfolio performance, profitability, scalability, and long-term strategic growth. This role leads the overall vision, operational architecture, financial performance, and market positioning of the DSP division while ensuring consistent client success across the portfolio.



This is not a manager role and not a specialist role. You are the business owner of the DSP function. You set the strategy, own the P&L, build the team, create the systems, and deliver results across the entire DSP organization.



Executive leadership will provide direction and resources, but ownership of outcomes rests with you. Success in this role requires strong leadership, financial acumen, operational excellence, organizational development expertise, and deep Amazon DSP knowledge.



If you need someone to tell you what to do every week, this isn't the right role for you.



Key Responsibilities:

- Own the overall performance, profitability, scalability, and growth of MAG's Amazon DSP division.

- Set the long-term DSP vision, service roadmap, pricing strategy, and growth plan.

- Drive portfolio-wide revenue growth, performance improvements, and client retention.

- Own the DSP P&L, including revenue, margins, forecasting, budgeting, and resource allocation.

- Develop pricing strategies that balance client value with agency profitability.

- Own the DSP SOP ecosystem and operational infrastructure.

- Serve as the executive owner and primary voice of DSP performance within the organization.

- Secure access to beta programs, premium inventory, strategic partnerships, and growth opportunities that strengthen MAG's competitive advantage.



Qualifications:

- 2+ years of experience leading large-scale DSP teams, portfolios, or business units.

- Deep expertise in Amazon DSP strategy, execution, optimization, measurement, and reporting.

- Proven success managing multi-million-dollar advertising portfolios and driving profitable growth.

- Experience owning departmental P&L, budgeting, forecasting, pricing strategy, and margin management.

- Experience creating SOPs, operational frameworks, automation systems, and scalable processes.

- Strong cross-functional leadership experience working with Sales, Operations, Creative, Finance, and Executive teams.

- Experience managing enterprise-level client relationships, strategic partnerships, and vendor negotiations.

- Existing relationships within the Amazon Advertising ecosystem preferred.

- MBA or equivalent executive business leadership experience is a plus.

- AI fluency



What We Offer:

- Competitive salary base

- Permanent WFH setup

- Unlimited FREE access to MAG School courses and SOP Library!

- Work schedule is in EST (Monday-Friday only)

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement



Your next big move starts here. If you’re ready to grow with a team that values your potential, apply now!

title: Property Marketing & Enquiries Virtual Assistant (SpareRoom)
description:
Working Hours: Approximately 30 hours per week

Friday - Monday: 12:00pm - 6:00pm (UK time)

Tuesday - Thursday: 4:00pm - 6:00pm (UK time)

Location: Remote



We're a growing UK property management company specialising in high-quality shared homes across multiple property portfolios. We're looking for a proactive, organised and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to take ownership of our SpareRoom advertising and applicant enquiries.



This role plays an important part in keeping our rooms occupied by ensuring our adverts are always presented professionally, renewed regularly throughout the day and that every enquiry receives a prompt, friendly and helpful response. You'll often be the first point of contact for prospective housemates, so excellent written communication and customer service are essential.



Your responsibilities will include creating new SpareRoom adverts using our templates, writing and updating advert descriptions, uploading photographs, creating lead images in Canva where required, ensuring all advert settings and tick boxes are correct, renewing adverts throughout the day and monitoring advert performance.



You'll also respond to applicant enquiries, answer common questions, collect contact details, qualify applicants using our criteria and pass suitable leads to the relevant Property Manager for arranging viewings. At the end of each shift, you'll provide a clear handover outlining who you've spoken to, what actions have been taken and anything that requires follow-up.



We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in producing accurate work and is confident working independently. Full training will be provided on our systems and processes, so previous property experience isn't essential. However, excellent written English, strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to follow processes consistently are all essential. Experience with Canva, customer service, online messaging or property advertising platforms such as SpareRoom would be an advantage.



You'll be using a variety of online systems including SpareRoom, Canva, Trello, Google Workspace and WhatsApp, with full training provided where needed.



Although this role is initially focused on SpareRoom management, we're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team. As our business continues to grow, there will be opportunities to become involved in other areas including property marketing, administration and customer support.



If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you. When applying, please tell us about any experience you have with customer service, online advertising or virtual assistant work. We'd also like you to answer one short question:



How would you respond if somebody sent you the following message on SpareRoom?



"Hi, is this room still available?"

title: Amazon Brand & PPC Manager
description:
We're hiring an Amazon Brand & Catalogue Manager to fully own our Amazon presence across all marketplaces we sell on (UK and EU), plus visibility into our eBay, B&Q The Range, and other Website channels.

This is not a bid-tuner role. Using our proprietary framework (built on Titan's PPC 3.0 methodology), under 5% of real performance problems turn out to be PPC — most wins come from price, listing, product, or inventory fixes further up the funnel. You'll run a monthly diagnostic across our active parent products, assign each one a State (Scale/Optimize/Hold/Recover) and a Driver (the one thing actually holding it back), then execute the right fix — PPC or otherwise.

What you'll own:



Full responsibility for growing profitability across the catalogue, on every marketplace we sell on — not just running campaigns, but genuinely moving the margin needle

Run our monthly ranking + diagnostic process (Combined Rank Analysis ? Titan PPC Audit) and assign every product a State + Driver + Execution Focus

Catalogue management end to end: build and upload flat files for bulk listing changes, fix broken or incomplete parent/child variations, and keep every marketplace listing accurate and complete

Competitor analysis to actively spot opportunities — gaps in keywords, pricing, positioning, or category coverage that we're not yet capturing

Build and maintain PPC campaigns to a structured 3-phase framework, following a defined bid waterfall and 4-week operating cadence

Diagnose and fix  product, price, and listing issues — you coordinate, not do every creative task yourself

Keep inventory signals current across every channel (we're FBM, so on-hand stock isn't visible to our tools — you'll be given it directly)

Submit a one-page weekly scorecard and log every change you make, with the data and reasoning behind it



What we expect:



You work to clear guardrails and flag anything outside them with data, before it becomes a problem

You bring solutions, not problems — data, two options, and your recommendation

You don't churn strategy weekly — states are stable, revisited monthly, reset quarterly



Tools: Titan Tools, Titan AI Connect (via Claude), Amazon Seller Central / Ads Console, flat file templates. Full training curriculum and our own internal playbooks provided — you'll ramp at your own pace, not a fixed daily quota.



You're a strong fit if: you have 5+ years managing Amazon accounts at a senior or ownership level — not as a task-executor on someone else's instructions, but as the person who d
 the strategy. PPC and catalogue/listing management are both genuinely second nature: you've built and managed flat files without guidance, fixed broken parent/child variation structures from scratch, and run competitor analysis that led to real pricing or positioning decisions — not just spreadsheets nobody acted on.



This role is not a fit if: you're early-career, primarily execute tasks assigned by someone else, or would need training on Seller Central basics, flat file structure, or campaign fundamentals. Workload Expectations

title: Part-Time Contractor Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Part-Time Contractor Coordinator to contact, qualify, schedule, and follow up with contractors on behalf of our company.



This is a contractor-facing operations role. You will communicate with contractors by phone,
, and text. You will not communicate with our clients or patients.



We will give you the information needed for each request. Your job is to communicate accurately, gather the required information, keep the tracker current, and move the request to its next step. You must never guess at or independently answer a technical question. Any technical question must be recorded and escalated to the team.



Schedule

This role provides three paid working hours per day, Monday through Friday, for a total of 15 paid hours per week.



The specific three hours may be different on different days. Each day's three-hour block must fall entirely between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time. This is not a fixed daily shift, but reliable weekday coverage within that window is required.



Responsibilities

- Contact contractors by phone,
, and text.

- Introduce the company and explain the reason for contact using the project information provided by the team.

- Confirm whether the contractor serves the relevant location.

- Confirm whether the contractor has experience relevant to the approved scope.

- Ask about availability, lead time, and the contractor's quote or estimate process.

- Request relevant qualifications, licensing, and insurance information where applicable.

- Arrange appointments using the scheduling information provided by the company.

- Follow up professionally when a contractor has not responded, when information is missing, or when a promised quote has not arrived.

- Maintain an accurate contractor tracker with contact details, outreach attempts, responses, qualifications, availability, quote status, and appointment status.

- Record a clear next action after every interaction.

- Escalate technical questions, unclear scope items, and decisions requiring the company's input.

- Find and contact an alternative contractor when directed or when the agreed follow-up process calls for one.

- Protect private information and share only the minimum information a contractor needs for the approved request.



Important Role Boundaries

- You communicate with contractors only. You do not communicate with clients or patients.

- You never provide technical advice or independently answer a contractor's technical question.

- If you are unsure, record the question and escalate it to the team instead of guessing.



Requirements

- Clear spoken and written English.

- Experience making outbound and follow-up calls in a professional role.

- Professional, polite persistence across phone,
, and text follow-up.

- Very organized, with the ability to manage multiple contractor follow-ups without losing track of details.

- Accurate recordkeeping and confidence maintaining a contractor tracker.

- Experience using Notion.

- Able to record a specific next action after every interaction.

- Able to communicate project information accurately without adding unsupported details.

- Good judgment about when to follow up, when to escalate, and when an alternative contractor may be needed.

- Available for three paid hours each Monday through Friday, with each day's hours falling entirely between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.



Hiring Process

- Complete a short Tally Form application 

- After submitting the form, complete one short recorded response in XInterviewAI using the same
 address.

- We will review the written application and recorded response together.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid trial.



Please do not submit a separate Loom recording. The XInterviewAI recording is the only recorded response requested at the application stage.



Compensation is set at $4 to $7 USD per hour, depending on experience.

title: Video Editor for English News/Business YouTube Channel — Long-Term, 8–10 videos/month
description:
Video Editor for English News/Business YouTube Channel — Long-Term, 8–10 videos/month



Start: immediately, after a PAID test edit.

Workload: 2 videos/week now, 3/week within a few months. Stable long-term work, not a one-off gig.



About the channel



New English-language YouTube channel covering the biggest stories in money, power, tech, AI and internet scandals. Documentary-commentary style: host on camera + documents, screenshots, charts and licensed b-roll. Think Johnny Harris / ColdFusion / Moon pacing — fast, clean, evidence-driven. NOT a cheap compilation channel, NOT a faceless automation channel.



What you deliver per episode





16:9 long-form master (7–11 min): jump cuts, b-roll, on-screen documents with zoom/highlight, simple motion graphics (lower thirds, money-flow arrows), accurate captions, music + SFX, color and audio cleanup.

Clean 9:16 vertical master (no watermarks, no platform logos).

2 vertical clips (20–60 sec) cut from the episode, delivered BEFORE the episode goes live.





How we work (read carefully — this is where most editors fail)





You edit from a timecoded editing script: every visual beat is written down, every external asset has a source ID and sits in an approved folder.

Hard rule: you never download footage yourself. No random YouTube clips, no "free" stock without license, no AI images added on your own. Every asset you use must come from our approved folder. One violation ends the contract — this is a legal requirement of the channel, not a preference.

Captions must match the spoken audio word for word. Names, numbers and currencies must be exact.

Turnaround: first draft within 48 hours of receiving materials. Maximum 2 revision rounds per video (revisions are timecoded, so they're quick).

Software: DaVinci Resolve preferred (free), Premiere accepted. You work in our project template after onboarding.

Async communication in English (written), files via Google Drive.





Pay





Flat rate per finished episode package (long-form + vertical master + 2 clips). Tell us your rate — we expect USD $X–XX depending on skill and speed.

Paid test: first episode edit from provided A-roll + assets (same test for all candidates). 

Rate grows with the channel: editors who hold quality at 3 videos/week get a raise after month 3.





Requirements





2+ links to videos YOU edited in a similar style (news, business, documentary, commentary). Compilation/slideshow channels don't count.

Solid English comprehension (you'll work from English scripts and audio).

Reliable internet + machine that handles 1080p/4K timelines.

title: Customer Service & Business Development Executive
description:
Customer Service & Business Development Executive

We're looking for a dynamic, well-spoken individual to join the SuperClean SG team as a Customer Service & Business Development Executive — a hybrid role that combines exceptional customer care with proactive outreach to grow our office and commercial cleaning business.



About SuperClean SG (
)

SuperClean SG is Singapore's fastest-growing, technology-enabled cleaning company, redefining how cleaning services are booked and delivered. We leverage technology to streamline operations, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and top-tier service quality for our customers.



We are relentlessly focused on our customers, always striving to exceed expectations and deliver an exceptional experience. Our goal is simple — reliable, high-quality service that makes our customers' lives better, whether that means making their day easier or giving them peace of mind.

As a young and dynamic company, we seek like-minded individuals passionate about service excellence, communication, and growth. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to be part of a company that values your contribution, join us and help shape the future of cleaning in Singapore.



What You'll Do



Customer Service

- Inbound Inquiries & Bookings: Handle customer inquiries via phone, WhatsApp, and
, guiding customers through booking options and answering service-related questions with clarity and confidence.

- Job Confirmations & Scheduling Support: Work closely with operations to confirm bookings, assign cleaners, and accommodate special requests.

- Client Issues & Escalations: Address complaints, investigate service issues, and resolve disputes efficiently with a professional, empathetic tone.

- Client-Initiated Changes: Process amendments, rescheduling, and cancellations while minimising disruption to operations.

- Service Quality Follow-ups: Check in with clients post-service to gather feedback and reinforce our commitment to quality.

- Invoice & Payment Support: Assist customers with billing and payments, coordinating with Finance on disputed invoices.



Sales & Business Development

- Outbound Prospecting: Proactively reach potential office and commercial cleaning clients through
, messaging platforms, calls, and other channels — opening conversations, generating interest, and booking site visits or quotes.

- Lead Qualification & Follow-up: Manage a pipeline of prospects, follow up consistently, and nurture leads from first contact through to closed deal.

- Quotations & Proposals: Prepare and send service quotes for office cleaning prospects, coordinating with operations on scoping and pricing.



Across the Board

- Customer Retention & Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with repeat and commercial clients, driving satisfaction, loyalty, and referrals.

- Process & SOP Development: Help build and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for both customer service and outbound initiatives — turning what works into clear, repeatable steps the team can follow.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Operations and Finance to ensure smooth service delivery, accurate quotes, and timely issue resolution.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent Spoken & Written English: Confident, clear, and professional on the phone and in writing — comfortable cold-calling and handling inbound calls with poise. (Additional languages such as Mandarin a plus.)

- Customer Service Experience: Prior experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in service-based industries such as cleaning, hospitality, or facilities management.

- Sales Instinct: Comfortable with outbound outreach and not afraid to pick up the phone or send the first message; motivated by hitting targets and closing deals.

- Problem-Solving & Conflict Resolution: Skilled at turning negative experiences into positive outcomes.

- Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: Comfortable using CRM, ticketing, and scheduling tools to manage customer and prospect interactions efficiently.

- Detail-Oriented & Organised: Tracks multiple inquiries, prospects, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to Document Processes: Can write clear, practical SOPs and playbooks so good practices get shared and scaled across the team.

- Self-Driven & Resilient: Thrives in a fast-paced environment, stays motivated through rejection, and manages high volumes while maintaining quality.

- Team Player: Works well with Operations and Finance to ensure smooth execution.



Working Arrangements

- 6-day work week, including weekends and Singapore public holidays (on a roster), in line with our service operating hours.



Why Join Us?

- Be part of a fast-growing, innovative company that values your contributions.

- A hybrid role with real ownership — your outreach directly fuels our commercial growth.

- A dynamic, supportive team with genuine opportunities for advancement.

- Competitive salary with performance incentives tied to sales results.

If you're ready to make an impact in a customer-focused, growth-driven environment and help shape the future of cleaning in Singapore, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Inventory Assistant
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





THE OPPORTUNITY

As Inventory Assistant, you will work at the operational heart of the Inventory team, keeping stock records accurate, Amazon FBA running cleanly, and our third-party logistics partners on track. This is not a passive role. You will be the person who catches discrepancies before they become customer problems, flags low stock before it becomes a lost sale, and ensures that every shipment entering or leaving the warehouse is accounted for correctly.



The role covers the full operational breadth of inventory management: from daily stock reconciliation across the IM Sheet and Power BI dashboards, to managing Amazon Seller Central shipments and processing FBA reimbursements, to coordinating with 3PL partners on inbound and outbound fulfilment. New product launches, including wallets, notebooks, and leather accessories targeting Q3 2026, will add meaningful scope and pace to the role over the coming months.



If you are someone who finds genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, who catches errors others walk past, and who wants to understand how a premium e-commerce brand actually operates end-to-end, this role will give you exactly that.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Stock Management and Control

Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory records across the IM Sheet, Power BI dashboards, and all active e-commerce platforms — these records are the operational source of truth for the business

Update and manage stock levels on the Faire and Turis wholesale platforms, ensuring availability is always reflected correctly for trade buyers

Conduct regular cycle counts, spot checks, and full stocktakes; investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage before they escalate

Monitor stock levels proactively and flag low-inventory or overstock situations to the Inventory Manager



Order Management and 3PL Coordination

Import and process orders into 3PL partner systems, double-checking previous orders for unfulfilled or incomplete items

Prepare and coordinate retail orders for dispatch, liaising with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment

Process incoming shipments from suppliers and freight carriers, verifying quantities and quality, resolving delivery discrepancies, and updating stock records accurately



Amazon Seller Central and FBA Operations

Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments end-to-end in Seller Central, including video verification, status tracking, and updating the Shipment Status File

Process FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units, maintaining accurate dispute records



Reporting and Compliance

Prepare and distribute the OD Weekly Report; update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies

Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI

Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions

Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team



WHO YOU ARE

Essential

Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment

Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination

Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious

Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis

A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked



Desirable

Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis

Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing

Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims

Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices

Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly.

Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time.

3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers.

The OD Weekly Report and compliance records are maintained consistently and without prompting.

The Inventory Manager can rely on your data to make confident stock and buying decisions.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out a form here: 



Only applications submitted through the form will be considered.

title: Direct Response Video Editor — AI UGC + VSL Ads (Skincare Brand, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We're a fast-scaling US skincare/wellness brand spending heavily on Meta and TikTok every month. Our ads are the engine of the business — which means the editor who cuts them is one of the most important people on the team.

We're looking for ONE elite editor. Not a generalist. Not a wedding videographer learning ads. Someone who already lives and breathes direct response.

WHAT YOU'LL EDIT:



AI UGC ads — assembling AI-generated talking-head clips (Seedance, Kling, Veo outputs) into native-feeling TikTok/Meta ads. You'll stitch segments, clean transitions, add captions, b-roll, and product shots so the final ad looks like a real creator filmed it on a phone.

VSL-style ads — longer-form direct response (60s–5min): hook, lead, mechanism, proof, offer. You understand pacing that holds retention, not pacing that looks cool.

Iteration velocity — taking a winning ad and cutting 5–10 hook/opening variations same day.



YOU'RE A FIT IF:



2+ years editing DIRECT RESPONSE ads specifically (Meta/TikTok DTC ads — show us, don't tell us)

You know what a hook rate and hold rate are and edit to move them

Fast: a 30–60s UGC ad in 2–4 hours, not 2 days

CapCut Pro AND Premiere Pro (or DaVinci) — both, fluently

Comfortable working with AI-generated footage: fixing seams, matching color/audio across generated clips, hiding AI artifacts

Native-quality captions, sound design, and pattern-interrupt cuts are second nature

You take a script + raw assets and deliver finished ads without hand-holding



BONUS POINTS:



Experience with skincare/beauty ads

You've used Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, or similar

Basic motion graphics (before/afters, benefit callouts, review overlays)

You've worked with US/AU DTC brands spending $50k+/month



WHAT YOU GET:



Long-term full-time role — we keep A-players for years

Direct line to the founder, zero bureaucracy

Volume of work that will make you dangerous: you'll cut more ads in 3 months here than most editors cut in 2 years

13th month pay after 1 year



HOW TO APPLY:



Subject line must start with the word "RETENTION" — applications without it are auto-deleted.

Link to 3–5 direct response ads YOU edited (Meta/TikTok DTC ads only — no wedding videos, no corporate reels, no vlogs).

One sentence: which ad is your best and why it performed.

Your CapCut/Premiere proficiency (1–10 each) and your average turnaround for a 45s UGC ad.

Expected monthly salary.



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test edit ($20–30) using our real assets before any offer.

title: Customer Service Agent
description:
We’re Samako, a fast-growing e-commerce brand from the Netherlands. With over 100,000 happy customers and strong traction on Bol, Amazon, and our own webshop, we’re building a new standard in the cleaning space. Our customers love us for our clever products and exceptional service — and we’re now looking for a full-time Customer Service Assistant (40 hours per week) to help us take that to the next level.



You’ll be working directly with our Dutch customer service lead and play a vital role in making sure our customers get the quick, helpful, and friendly support they deserve.



What’s in Store for You?



This is a remote, full-time role with a shift-based setup. Coverage from 7 to 4 pm or from 2 pm till 11 pm Dutch hours, and availability on Sundays is a must.



Onboarding will take place during office hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM) throughout the first month.



We value quality over volume. We’d rather you take a bit longer and give an excellent answer than rush through tickets. You’ll be representing our brand, so tone, care, and clarity are key.



Who Are We Looking For?



We’re looking for someone who is friendly, sharp, and takes pride in great communication. Ideally, you:



- Have experience with customer service (e-commerce is a plus)

- Write and speak excellent English, clearly and professionally

- Are available for full-time work (40 hours/week) and can work Dutch office hours as well as evenings and weekends

- Communicate empathetically, calmly, and professionally, even when a customer is upset

- Are proactive and like solving problems on your own

- Are comfortable using tools like Gorgias, Bol, Seller Central, and Shopify (or are quick to learn)

- Are detail-oriented and comfortable handling refunds, returns, and tracking issues

- Can collaborate well with others and clearly hand off tasks or updates







What You’ll Do:

- Respond to customer messages via Gorgias and platform inboxes (Bol, Amazon, Shopify)

- Help customers with product questions, delivery issues, and returns

- Escalate or flag tickets to our Dutch support lead when needed

- Collaborate with our logistics team to resolve delivery problems

- Ensure that every customer feels helped, heard, and happy



What We Offer:



- A flexible, remote-first full-time role (40 hours/week)

- Shift-based structure with a focus on coverage and quality

- Supportive team culture where initiative is valued

- Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving e-commerce brand

- Competitive compensation based on your experience



Ready to Join Us?



If you love helping people, communicate with care, and are ready to jump into a fast-growing startup — we’d love to hear from you.



Apply via this form:







We look forward to reviewing your application and seeing how you can make an impact!

title: Web dev, AI Automation Manager and Creator Partnerships & AI Automation Manager
description:
WEB DEVELOPER, AI AUTOMATION AND CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER



Full-Time Remote Position — Philippines



Company: Alpine Provisions



Location: Remote, Philippines



Schedule: Full-time with partial overlap with United States business hours



Reports to: Founder and Marketing Leadership



Compensation: $1,500–$2,500 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability



Employment Type: Long-term remote contractor



ABOUT ALPINE PROVISIONS



Alpine Provisions is a premium body-care company inspired by mountains, nature and outdoor living.



Our products use mountain-sourced essential oils, elevated natural scent profiles and plastic-conscious packaging. Our customers are active, health-conscious people who care about how they look, feel, smell and live.



Approximately 75 percent of our customers are men and 25 percent are women.



We are building a scalable creator partnership program that recruits outdoor, fitness, grooming, wellness, dating, lifestyle and personal-care creators to produce high-performing user-generated content for Alpine Provisions.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a highly capable Web Developer, AI Automation and Creator Partnerships Manager to build, manage and continuously improve our creator recruitment and UGC operations system.



This is not a standard virtual assistant position.



The ideal candidate is a technically skilled operator who can build web-based systems, create AI automations, connect software platforms, troubleshoot workflows and manage creator outreach and partnerships.



The role combines:



Web development



AI workflow design



No-code and low-code automation



API and webhook integrations



Creator research and outreach



CRM development and management



Shopify and ShipBob operations



Creator applications and onboarding



Content uploads and approvals



Affiliate attribution and commission management



Reporting and process improvement



You will build and manage the system that moves a creator through the following process:



Creator discovered



Creator qualified



Creator contacted



Creator responds



Creator completes an application



Creator signs an agreement



Product is shipped



Delivery is confirmed



Content is submitted



Content is reviewed and approved



Advertising permissions are collected



Sales are attributed



Commission is calculated and paid



You should be equally comfortable building a website or creator portal, creating an automation in Make or Zapier, organizing data in Airtable, connecting APIs, troubleshooting Shopify workflows and communicating professionally with creators.



We need someone who takes ownership. You must be able to identify problems, recommend better solutions, document processes and manage the entire creator partnership pipeline.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BUILD THE CREATOR MANAGEMENT PLATFORM



Design, build and maintain a centralized platform for managing creators from initial discovery through commission payment.



The system should track:



Creator name and contact information



Instagram and TikTok handles



Follower count



Content category



Audience information



Creator qualification score



Outreach history



Application status



Agreement status



Shipping address



Assigned products



Product shipment



Tracking number



Delivery confirmation



Content deadline



Submitted content



Revision requests



Approval status



Meta Partnership Ad permissions



Attributed sales



Commission earned



Payment status



The final system may use a combination of custom web development, Airtable, Shopify, Make, Zapier, Google Workspace, Slack, Meta tools, affiliate platforms and other approved software.



The system must be organized, secure, reliable and easy for the Alpine team and creators to use.



2. DEVELOP WEB-BASED CREATOR EXPERIENCES



Build and manage an Alpine-branded creator website or portal.



The creator portal should allow creators to:



Create a profile



Enter their name and contact information



Submit their Instagram and TikTok handles



Enter their follower count



Provide audience information



Enter their shipping address



Select or receive an assigned product



Review campaign instructions



Sign agreements



View shipping status



Access scripts and production briefs



Upload raw and edited content



Receive revision requests



View approval status



View attributed sales and commissions



The portal should be mobile-friendly, professional and simple to use.



You should understand user experience, website structure, forms, databases, authentication and secure file uploads.



3. DEVELOP AI AND AUTOMATION WORKFLOWS



Build and maintain automations that reduce manual work throughout the creator program.



Automations may include:



Scoring creators based on Alpine’s ideal creator profiles



Categorizing creators by niche and archetype



Generating personalized outreach messages



Creating creator records automatically



Detecting creator replies



Updating outreach statuses



Sending an application link when a creator expresses interest



Sending follow-up reminders



Triggering agreements and onboarding instructions



Creating creator product orders



Updating shipping and delivery statuses



Sending delivery notifications



Sending content reminders



Organizing uploaded content



Alerting managers when content requires review



Generating unique creator links and codes



Calculating eligible commissions



Creating weekly performance reports



All automations must be reliable, documented and compliant with platform policies.



We are not looking for unsafe Instagram bots, unauthorized scraping systems or automations that place Alpine’s accounts at risk.



4. CONNECT SHOPIFY AND SHIPBOB



Build and manage the process that sends approved creators a UGC product package.



The workflow should:



Create or trigger a creator sample order in Shopify



Apply the correct creator and campaign tags



Send the order to ShipBob



Confirm fulfillment



Capture the tracking number



Update the creator’s profile



Notify the creator when the package ships



Notify the Alpine manager when the package is delivered



Trigger content deadlines after delivery



Prevent duplicate or unauthorized shipments



You should be comfortable working with Shopify, ShipBob, APIs, webhooks, order tags and fulfillment exceptions.

Professionalism

The goal is to identify creators whose content can represent Alpine and sell the product.



6. MANAGE CREATOR OUTREACH



Manage consistent and personalized outreach through Instagram and
.

Explaining deadlines and deliverables



Answering creator questions



Maintaining accurate creator records



Creators should receive a professional, organized and responsive experience.



8. MANAGE UGC CONTENT COLLECTION AND APPROVAL

You will manage:



Script assignments



Production briefs



Shot lists



Content deadlines



File uploads



Raw footage



Edited videos



Opening hook variations



Call-to-action variations



Revision requests



Final approvals



Meta Partnership Ad permissions

Correct vertical format

Lighting quality



Product visibility



Missing deliverables



Copyrighted music



Platform watermarks



Competitor logos



Unsupported product claims



Incorrect brand messaging



Final creative approval will be completed with Alpine’s marketing leadership.



9. MANAGE ATTRIBUTION AND CREATOR COMMISSIONS



Maintain accurate records of creator-attributed sales and commissions.



This may include:



Creating unique creator links



Creating creator codes



Adding UTM tracking parameters



Connecting creators to an affiliate platform



Reviewing Shopify order attribution



Identifying first-time customer orders



Removing refunds, cancellations and chargebacks



Preparing commission statements



Flagging attribution disputes



Coordinating creator payouts



Maintaining payment records

Outreach messages sent



Response rate



Interested creator rate

Workflow failures



Recommended improvements

APIs and webhooks

 outreach tools

title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as our Creative Operations Manager and take full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department, including video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run: capacity, output, deadlines, systems, and people.



This is a leadership role. You will be trusted to own outcomes, not micromanaged on tasks. If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You’ll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt, you’ll know who has room for more work, who is overloaded, and what is at risk of slipping before anyone asks.



You don’t manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance directly, and make difficult people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.



What You’ll Own



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning



* Own the creative operations dashboard, including capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

* Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they affect production.

* Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

* Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

* When a number drops, find the leak and put a fix in place.



The Team



* Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters and other creative tea
mbers in scope when needed.

* Run interviews and assess talent effectively. Hiring is a core part of this role.

* Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

* Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, identify the problem, set a clear improvement plan with a deadline, and make the final call if they do not meet expectations.



Process, Systems, and AI



* Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

* Ensure every project has an owner, a deadline, and a clear status.

* Use AI daily to multiply output through SOP creation, data analysis, automation, reporting, and forecasting.

* Grow production capacity without automatically growing headcount.

* Work confidently with spreadsheets and automation tools.

* Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership aligned so production never stops.



Before You Apply



We want to be transparent and respectful of everyone’s time.



This is a senior management position, not an assistant, coordinator, specialist, or first-time leadership role. To be considered, you must have at least three years of direct experience in both e-commerce and operations management, including experience working specifically as an Operations Manager or in a genuinely equivalent management position.



Experience as an assistant, team lead, project coordinator, or individual contributor will not meet the requirements for this role unless you also have the required Operations Manager experience.



Applications that do not clearly demonstrate at least three years of relevant e-commerce operations management experience will be automatically disqualified. Please apply only if your background matches this requirement.



Must-Haves



* At least three years of direct experience as an Operations Manager or in an equivalent management role within e-commerce.

* Experience managing teams, ideally creative, production, or operational teams.

* Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

* A direct communicator who does not avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and do not let issues sit.

* Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, with proven experience doing so.

* Proven experience running structured interviews and making hiring decisions.

* Strong data skills. You are highly capable with spreadsheets and understand when to use a median instead of an average.

* Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and able to learn new software quickly.

* Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily operations work. You can clearly explain which tools you use, how you use them, and why.

* Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who is stuck and what is blocking them.

* Strong written and spoken English. You will run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

* Daily availability from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time, GMT+8, with reasonable availability when urgent issues arise.



Nice-to-Haves



* Experience managing video editors, designers, copywriters, or other creative production teams at scale.

* Experience building or owning a capacity, utilization, or KPI dashboard.

* Strong experience with ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar tools.

* Experience building AI workflows or automations.

* A basic understanding of video production workflows. You do not need to edit, but you need to understand what “done” and “good” look like.



Our Hiring Process



We move quickly while respecting your time.



1. Fill out our quick application form. It includes simple questions and takes around five minutes.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview focused on experience and culture fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

title: Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online, Certified)
description:

It's a steady, part-time role at the heart of how we keep the company's foundation solid.



What You'll Be Doing

 - Day to day, you focus on the books while payments stay separate by design. Who You Are

 - A certified bookkeeper who takes ownership of accuracy.

 - You have the accounting fundamentals down cold and you're fluent in QuickBooks Online. You catch the thing that doesn't   add up, document it clearly, and communicate it before it becomes a problem. You're comfortable with technology and open to using AI to take the manual grind out of finance work. You're trustworthy with sensitive financial information, and you work well independently in a remote, contractor-based team.



? Requirements

 - Solid bookkeeping experience and a strong grasp of accounting fundamentals

 - QuickBooks Online proficiency with current QBO certification (ProAdvisor or equivalent) — please include proof

 - Comfortable owning a monthly close and reconciliations independently

 - Detail-oriented and communicative — you surface issues early

 - Trustworthy and discreet — this role involves backup access to payments, so integrity and a clean track record matter

 - Reliable internet and availability for some overlap with PH business hours



Bonus Points If You…

 - Are comfortable using AI to automate work — we run on Claude (Claude Code / Cowork) for automation, and we'd love someone keen to use it to streamline the close, cut manual data entry, and connect our finance tools

 - Have experience automating finance or bookkeeping workflows in any form

 - Know your way around PayPal reporting and reconciliation

 - Have worked with a remote, contractor-based team before



What You'll Get

 - USD 700/month for ~20 hrs/week, based on skills and experience

 - Service Quality Incentive — a discretionary performance incentive, available after successful completion of probation

 - Paid leave, available after probation, plus the GML Christmas break (Dec 24 – Jan 1)

 - Remote-first, async-friendly culture — results over hours

 - A role at the foundation of the company, with real ownership of how our finances run

 - A sharp team and strong values — Competence, Adaptability, Trust, Collaboration, Humanity, and no fluff



How to Apply (Follow These Steps Precisely)

Please
 the following to 
 with the subject:

“Bookkeeper – I'm [Your Name] and I Keep the Books Bulletproof”

Include:

 - Your resume with two professional references

 - Proof of your current QuickBooks Online certification

)

Our selection process

We want to see the work, not just talk about it — so every applicant goes through the same steps:

title: Creative Strategist (Direct Response/Ecommerce)
description:
We're Madam Muse, a fast-growing women's wireless bra and underwear brand. Our customers are women aged 45 to 65 in the US, UK and Canada. We run heavy paid social and we're expanding our creative team. We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own the ideas behind our ads: the angles, hooks and concepts that stop the scroll and sell.



This is a thinking and directing role, not a production role. You come up with the concepts and write the briefs. Our editors, designers and UGC creators produce them. You then read the data, find the winners, work out why they won, and do it again at volume.



What you'll own

• Develop ad angles, hooks and concepts rooted in customer psychology: what our customer actually feels, fears and wants (comfort, fit, no underwire)

• Find new untapped angles, awareness stages, personas

• Write clear creative briefs for statics, UGC and video (our team executes them)

• Research the market and competitors (Meta Ad Library, tools like Atria) and turn winning patterns into original Madam Muse concepts. We don't copy, we out-execute

• Analyze performance (hook rate, thumbstop, CTR, ROAS): find the winners, understand why they work, iterate fast

 Keep a constant pipeline of testable concepts flowing so the media buyer always has fresh creative to scale

• Turn winners into new variations (new hooks, angles, formats), then repeat



What we're looking for

• Proven creative strategy for e-commerce / DTC brands on paid social. You've briefed ads that actually performed

• Strong direct-response instinct: hooks, angles, customer psychology, scroll-stopping ideas

• Data-driven. Comfortable reading ad metrics and drawing conclusions

• Great written English and copy instincts (you can write a hook)

• Fast, high-volume thinker. Organized and proactive. Owns outcomes without hand-holding

• Bonus: experience with women's, apparel, beauty or wellness brands, or you've run ad accounts yourself



Success looks like

A steady flow of fresh, testable concepts every week

A rising hit-rate of winning ads that we scale

Clear briefs the team can execute without back-and-forth

You can explain why our best ads win, and reproduce it



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word "ANGLE" so we know you read this.

2. Share examples of ad creative you've strategized or briefed that performed well (with results or metrics if you can).

3. Give us ONE hook plus angle you'd test for our wireless bra targeting women 45 to 65, and why it would work.

4. Pick any winning DTC ad (yours or not) and explain in 2 to 3 sentences why it works.



Applications that skip these steps won't be considered.

title: General Manager
description:
Role Summary



The General Manager is the first management hire at Outlead Me, activated when the business reaches 5

active clients. You are the operational backbone of the company — sitting between the founders and the

executor team. You own day-to-day operations, team performance, client escalations, and internal process

health. You free the founders to focus on growth.



Key Responsibilities

• Oversee all three departments (Product, Sales & Marketing, Finance) and ensure weekly delivery standards

are met

• Run the weekly internal team meeting — set agenda, track actions, hold team accountable to deadlines

• Own the master task board (Notion/ClickUp) — ensure all client deliverables are logged, assigned, and

completed on time

• Manage escalations from clients or team members — resolve issues within 24 hours or escalate to founders

with a proposed solution

• Review all weekly client reports before they are sent — no report goes out without GM approval

• Maintain and improve all SOPs — identify gaps, document new processes, and ensure the team follows them

• Own hiring logistics — job post live, trial task sent, candidate shortlist delivered to founders within 5 business

days of requisition

• Track team KPIs weekly: on-time delivery rate, client satisfaction, campaign performance, internal pipeline

progress

• Conduct monthly 1:1s with each team member — identify performance issues, training needs, and growth

opportunities

• Report weekly to founders: operations summary, blockers, wins, and team pulse



Required Skills & Experience

• 3+ years operations or project management experience, preferably in a remote or agency environment

• Fluent written and spoken English — you will communicate directly with founders and manage team comms

• Strong with project management tools (Notion, ClickUp, Asana, or similar)

• Experience managing small teams remotely — comfortable holding people accountable without being in the

same room

• Ability to read a P&L; and understand basic financial reporting

• Highly organised — never drops the ball, always follows up, keeps records of everything

• Experience in digital marketing, lead generation, or B2B services is a strong advantage

• Comfortable working across CRM tools (GoHighLevel a strong advantage)



Values & Character Fit

• You execute without being chased — founders should never have to follow up on you

• You take full ownership of your department and don't make excuses when things go wrong

• You are a systems thinker — you see gaps before they become problems

• You communicate clearly and directly — no ambiguity, no overcommunication, no under-communication

• You care about the team and want to develop the people around you

• You understand that client visibility is non-negotiable and enforce that standard daily



Onboarding Timeline

• Day 1–2: Full onboarding call with founders. Access to all tools, task board, SOPs, and client files reviewed.

• Day 3–5: Shadow existing workflow — review active client campaigns, weekly reports, and team task board.

• Week 2: Take ownership of internal team standup and task board. First weekly ops report to founders.

• Week 3: Own first client report review cycle. Flag any quality issues before reports go out.

• Month 1: Fully operational. Running team standup, managing task board, reviewing reports, tracking KPIs.

• Month 2: Lead first monthly 1:1 cycle with all team members. Deliver team health report to founders.



How to Apply

Submit your application to 
 with the subject line: [General Manager] — [Your Name]

Include a 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why this role is the right fit.



Our Operating Values

Execution Over Excuses

Ship. Deliver. Hit deadlines. Fix, don't explain.

Owned Outcomes

Everyone owns their output fully. No blame.

Systems Before Scale

Never grow faster than your ability to deliver.

Client Visibility

Weekly reports on time, every week. Silence is never acceptable.

Train to Delegate

Document everything. Knowledge is a team asset.

Hire for Values, Train for Skills

Character first in every hire.

Asset Recovered Team is hiring English-speaking remote callers in the Philippines to contact potential claimants and connect interested individuals with our closing team.



This position is for someone who understands that success in outbound calling comes from consistency.



Not every person will answer. Not every conversation will result in an appointment. However, callers who continue making calls, follow the script, document each conversation, and consistently identify qualified claimants can create multiple opportunities to earn bonuses and commissions.



We provide:



* A power dialer to assist with 200 or more call attempts during a full shift

* CRM access

* Calling scripts

* Training

* Claimant lists

* Live-transfer and appointment-setting procedures



You are not responsible for closing the claim. Your job is to make the initial contact, verify the claimant, create interest, and connect them with a closer.



## Compensation and Bonuses



* $1 USD per hour

* Full-time or part-time

* 20 to 40 hours per week

* $10 weekly performance bonus for meeting attendance, call-volume, CRM-accuracy, and quality requirements



You may also earn:



* $1 for an accepted live transfer or successfully booked closer appointment

* Additional $1 when the claimant is confirmed as qualified

* Additional $1 when a booked claimant attends the appointment



These smaller bonuses allow you to earn from productive calls before a claim is completed.



## Earn 2% From Completed Claims



In addition to hourly pay and call-performance bonuses, you earn:



**2% of the amount Asset Recovered Team actually receives from each successfully completed claim you originate.**



Examples:



* Company receives $5,000: You earn $100

* Company receives $10,000: You earn $200

* Company receives $25,000: You earn $500

* Company receives $50,000: You earn $1,000



A qualified claimant can therefore produce small performance bonuses during the calling process and a much larger commission if the claim is successfully completed.



Commissions are paid after Asset Recovered Team receives cleared funds. Claims can take time to complete, and earnings are not guaranteed.



## Who Will Succeed?



This position may be right for you when you:



* Speak English clearly and professionally

* Are confident speaking with unfamiliar people

* Can remain positive after unanswered calls or rejection

* Understand that persistence creates more opportunities

* Follow instructions and scripts carefully

* Keep accurate CRM notes

* Are dependable and report to work on time

* Are motivated by performance bonuses and commission

* Can balance sales ability with respectful customer service



Previous calling, appointment-setting, customer-service, call-center, or sales experience is helpful, but training is provided.



## Requirements



* Strong spoken English

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Dependable computer

* Quality headset and microphone

* Quiet professional workspace

* Availability during assigned U.S. business hours

* Willingness to use a power dialer throughout the shift



Calling assignments may cover Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific Time depending on the U.S. states assigned.



## How to Apply



### Step 1



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



* Your résumé

* A brief description of your calling or customer-service experience

* Your answers to the screening questions

* Your Loom video link



### Step 2



Submit a two-to-four-minute Loom video explaining:



1. Your previous calling, customer-service, or sales experience

2. Why you are good at speaking with people

3. How you handle rejection and continue working

4. Why persistence is important in outbound calling

5. Your internet, computer, headset, and workspace

6. How many hours you can work each week

7. Which U.S. time zones you can cover

8. Why Asset Recovered Team should hire you

“Hello, my name is [Your Name], and I am calling from Asset Recovered Team. We are trying to reach [Claimant Name] regarding funds that may be associated with their name. I would like to verify that I am speaking with the correct person and connect you with a specialist who can provide additional information.”

title: Contracts & Procurement Manager
description:
Summary of the Position: 

The Contracts & Procurement Manager supports global contracting, procurement, and site agreement functions for the Company. This role is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing agreements with sponsors, vendors, consultants, and clinical research sites, while ensuring compliance with Company policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and sponsor expectations. 

This position serves as a key business partner to project teams, finance, and operational stakeholders by ensuring that contractual agreements, procurement activities, and vendor relationships are executed efficiently and alignment with clinical trial timelines and organizational objectives.  

This role requires strong legal and commercial contracting experience, excellent negotiation skills, and meticulous attention to detail.  

 The Contracts & Procurement Manager supports both commercial and government-funded projects and ensures compliance with applicable contractual and regulatory frameworks.  

 

Essential Functions: 

Sponsor & Vendor Contracting Management  

• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a portfolio of sponsor, vendor, consultant, and service provider agreements.  

• Manage confidentiality agreements, master service agreements, statements of work, consulting agreements, task orders, purchase orders, and amendments.  

• Review contractual terms to identify risks and provide recommendations for mitigation.  

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure contract terms align with project scope, budgets, and operational requirements.  

• Ensure contracts are properly executed and documents are within the Company systems and processes.  

 

Site Contracting Management 

• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage clinical trial agreements with investigative sites, including Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs), site CDAs, start-up agreements, letters of indemnification, and amendments. 

• Support the preparation and negotiation of site budgets aligned with study protocols and sponsor requirements. 

• Work with project teams to ensure timely completion of site contracts and alignment with study start-up timelines. 

• Maintain regular communication with sponsors, sites, and internal stakeholders regarding contract status and timelines. 

• Identify contractual risks or negotiation challenges and escalate issues appropriately. 

 

Procurement & Vendor Management  

• Support procurement processes related to vendors, consultants, and service providers supporting clinical research activities. 

• Manage vendor selection, contract execution, and purchase order processes in alignment with company procurement procedures. 

• Ensure vendors and sites are properly registered within the Company’s financial and contracting systems. 

• Maintain accurate records of procurement activities and vendor documentation. 

• Assist in vendor relationship management and contract lifecycle oversight. 



Government-Funded Project Compliance  

• Support contractual and procurement requirements for projects funded by government agencies or international donors. 

• Ensure compliance with donor-specific regulations, policies, and reporting requirements where applicable. 

• Assist project teams with contractual compliance for government-funded research programs. 

 

Operational Support  

• Maintain contract documentation and tracking systems to ensure transparency and audit 

readiness. 

• Participate in internal meetings with project teams and external stakeholders to discuss 

contractual matters. 

• Provide guidance to internal teams on contractual obligations, policies, and best practices. 

• Support development and improvement of departmental processes, templates, and 

standard operating procedures. 

• Perform quality checks to ensure contractual documentation is complete and compliant 

with company standards. 

 

Additional Responsibilities  

• Provide mentoring and guidance to junior team members as needed. 

• Support departmental initiatives aimed at improving contracting efficiency and 

operational processes. 

• Any other duties and responsibilities may be assigned from time to time. 

 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 

• Strong knowledge of clinical research contracting, including site contracts and vendor 

agreements. 

• Excellent contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills. 

• Strong understanding of commercial contracting principles and procurement processes. 

• Ability to identify contractual risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies. 

• High level of attention to detail and ability to manage complex documentation. 

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple 

priorities. 

• Ability to communicate complex legal and contractual concepts clearly to non-legal 

stakeholders. 

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams. 

• Experience working with contract lifecycle management systems and financial systems. 

 

Position Requirements 

Education: Bachelor of Law Degree or its international equivalent or an equivalent combination of formal legal training and relevant work experience. 



Preferred Job-related Experience:   

• Five (5) to seven (7) years of experience in contract management, procurement, or legal operations within a CRO, pharmaceutical company, or clinical research organization. 

• Experience negotiating: 

? Clinical trial agreements 

? Site contracts and budgets 

? Vendor and consultant agreements 

? Sponsor service agreements 

• Prior experience supporting government-funded research projects or donor-funded programs (e.g., USAID, NIH, or similar) strongly preferred. 

• Experience managing vendor procurement processes and contract lifecycle management.

 Ads Manager to take full ownership of our paid social strategy and drive strong, measurable results across multiple accounts.

Plan, build, and manage

title: Content Writer, Reddit
description:
Do you genuinely use Reddit every day?



Do you know the difference between a comment that sounds like marketing and one that sounds like a real person?

If that sounds like you, keep reading.



The Reddit Marketing Agency is looking for full time Content Writers who understand Reddit culture and know how real conversations happen on the platform.



This is not a traditional content writing role. If your experience is exclusively blog and SEO writing, this is probably not for you. 



You will be creating posts and comments for real Reddit communities across topics including health, beauty, technology, software, parenting, sleep, consumer products, and ecommerce. We are looking for people who already use Reddit as part of their daily lives and understand what makes content feel authentic, helpful, and interesting.



What you will do

1. Write Reddit posts that encourage discussion and engagement.

2. Write comments that feel natural and match the tone of each community.

3. Research subreddits and understand community rules and expectations.

4. Track conversations and identify opportunities for brands to participate naturally.

5. Work with our team to improve content performance over time.



Requirements

1. You are an active Reddit user.

2. You understand Reddit culture, humour, etiquette, and community norms.

3. You are an excellent English writer.

4. You can adapt your writing style to different communities and audiences.

5. You pay attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully.

6. Previous experience with content writing, community management, social media, or Reddit is preferred but not required.



How to apply

Please
 your application & CV to:





In your covering letter, please answer the following two questions:

1. Why do you love Reddit?

2. What experience do you have using Reddit, either personally or professionally?

Applications that do not answer both questions will not be considered.

title: Content VA / Video Content Mining Specialist — Wrestling & Combat Sports Media (Full-Time)
description:
Do you have an eye for what makes people stop scrolling?



We run two media brands in the combat sports space. We have over 10 years of video content — thousands of hours of training footage, match clips, coaching sessions, and behind-the-scenes 
nts — sitting in a vault waiting to be turned into viral Shorts, Reels, and TikToks.



We need someone obsessive about content to come in and systematically mine that library, find the gold, organize everything, and keep our social media engines running across multiple platforms and multiple brands every single day.



This isn't a "post once a day and call it done" gig. You'll be the backbone of our entire content operation — the person who makes sure our video editor always has clips to cut, our content calendar is always full, and our audience is always being fed.



The Two Brands You'll Be Working Across:



Brand 1 — Championship-level amateur wrestling instruction with 10+ years of training footage. Think intense, high-energy, coach-to-athlete content.



Brand 2 — Combat sports education and analysis. Deep library of instructional and analytical content.



What You'll Be Doing:



Content Mining & Organization (This Is the Big One — ~40% of Your Time)

- Systematically watch through our entire video libraries for both brands

- Log every video in a master spreadsheet: title, duration, topic, key 
nts with timestamps, "gold rating" (1–5), and suggested clip ideas

- Identify the 
nts that would make great Shorts — high energy technique demos, dramatic reactions, clean takedowns, quotable coaching 
nts, training montages, rivalry clips

- Tag and categorize content: technique tutorials, match footage, training sessions, coaching/motivational, behind-the-scenes, product-specific

- Organize raw files into a clean, labeled folder structure so our editor can find and grab what they need instantly

- Maintain and update the content log as new footage comes in



Content Scheduling & Posting (~30% of Your Time)

- Manage content calendars across both brands and all platforms (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok,
)

- Upload, write captions, add hashtags, and publish all finished content on schedule

- Write captions from templates and brand voice guides we provide (you'll get trained on each brand's tone)

- Schedule content in advance using tools like Metricool, Later, or native platform schedulers

- Ensure we never miss a posting day — consistency is everything



Community Engagement & Performance Tracking (~20% of Your Time)

- Monitor and reply to comments across all platforms (we'll give you response guidelines)

- Flag DMs and comments that need the founders' attention

- Track basic performance metrics weekly: views, engagement rate, follower growth, saves, shares

- Maintain a simple weekly report — what posted, what performed, what flopped, and why you think so

- Identify trending content in our niches and flag opportunities to jump on trends



Research & Support (~10% of Your Time)

- Research trending audio, formats, hashtags, and content styles in the wrestling and combat sports niche

- Scout competitor accounts and flag content ideas worth adapting or responding to

- Maintain asset libraries: thumbnails, brand templates, music/audio files, b-roll folders

- Assist with miscellaneous tasks as needed — we're a small team and flexibility matters



You MUST Have:



- Strong English skills (written — we communicate via chat, Loom, and shared docs)

- Experience managing social media accounts and posting content consistently (show us the accounts you've managed)

- Familiarity with at least one scheduling tool (Later, Buffer, Metricool, Hootsuite, or native platform schedulers)

- Attention to detail — you'll be logging hundreds of videos and we need accuracy, not sloppiness

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision after training

- A genuine eye for engaging content — you can tell the difference between a clip that will get 500 views and one that will get 50,000

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace with headphones (you'll be watching hours of video daily)

- Willingness to overlap with US Central Time (CST) for at least 3–4 hours daily

- Proficiency with Google Drive, Google Sheets, and basic file management



Bonus Points (Not Required But We'll Love You For It):



- Interest in wrestling, combat sports, or martial arts (understanding the content makes you faster)

- Experience with short-form video platforms as a creator or avid consumer (if your own TikTok For You page is full of combat sports content, tell us)

- Basic photo/video editing skills (even just CapCut-level trimming and captioning)

- Experience with Canva for creating thumbnails or simple graphics

- Familiarity with YouTube analytics, Instagram Insights, or TikTok analytics dashboards

- Experience working with content creators or media brands (not just corporate social accounts)



What It's Like Working With Us:



- Small team, fast-moving, zero bureaucracy

- You'll work directly with the founders — not middle managers

- We communicate async (Loom, Slack/chat) with a weekly sync call

- We'll train you on exactly what "gold" content looks like — you don't need to figure it out alone

- Clear expectations, direct feedback, and real growth opportunity

- If you're great at this, there's room to grow into a content manager role as we scale



To Apply — READ THIS CAREFULLY:



We get a lot of applications. To make sure you actually read this post, do the following:



1. Start your application with the word **"TAKEDOWN"** so we know you read the full posting.



2. Watch this video: 
 



3. In your application, timestamp 3 specific 
nts from that video that you think would make great Shorts or Reels. For each 
nt, write 1-2 sentences explaining WHY you picked it — what makes it engaging, scroll-stopping, or shareable.



4. Send links to 2-3 social media accounts you've managed or contributed to. If you don't have professional examples, send your own personal accounts and tell us what content strategy you follow.



5. Tell us your available hours, timezone, and current workload (are you working other jobs?).



**Do NOT send a generic application.** If your application doesn't start with "TAKEDOWN" and include timestamps, we won't read it.

title: GoHighLevel Expert & Implementer — Insurance Agency Setup (Full-Time Opportunity)
description:
Are you a GoHighLevel power user who loves building systems from scratch?



We're a growing life insurance and annuity brokerage based in Iowa, USA. We're licensed in all 50 states and scaling fast. We need someone who *lives and breathes* GoHighLevel to come in and build out our entire CRM, marketing, and sales infrastructure.



This isn't a "set it and forget it" gig. You'll be working directly with the founders to architect workflows, funnels, pipelines, and integrations that drive real revenue. If you're the type who geeks out over automation logic and clean funnel builds, keep reading.



What You'll Be Doing:



- Setting up and configuring our GoHighLevel account from the ground up

- Building sales pipelines with proper stages, automations, and lead routing

- Creating workflows for lead nurture, appointment booking, follow-up sequences, and re-engagement campaigns

- Building landing pages and funnels (we'll provide copy direction — you build and optimize)

- Integrating GHL with Meta Ads 
/Instagram), Google Ads, and other ad platforms via API or native connections

- Setting up tracking, attribution, and conversion reporting so we know what's working

- Configuring calendars, booking widgets, and round-robin scheduling for our sales team

- Implementing SMS and
 campaigns within GHL workflows

- Setting up Twilio, Mailgun, or other third-party integrations as needed

- Troubleshooting and optimizing — things break, pixels don't fire, workflows misroute. You fix it.

- Documenting everything you build (SOPs, Loom videos) so the team can manage it long-term



You MUST Have:



- 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience (not just "familiar with it" — you've actually built out accounts)

- Proven experience building multi-step workflows and automations in GHL

- Experience integrating 
 with
 Ads and/or Google Ads

- Funnel and landing page building experience inside GHL

- Understanding of pipeline management and CRM best practices

- Strong English communication skills (written — we communicate primarily via chat and Loom)

- Reliable internet and a professional home office setup

- Willingness to overlap with US Central Time (CST) for at least 3–4 hours daily



Bonus Points (Not Required But We'll Love You For It):



- Experience in the insurance, financial services, or annuity space

- Familiarity with compliance considerations for insurance/financial advertising

- Experience with Zapier, 
, or N8N for advanced integrations

- Knowledge of
 Ad compliance and policy nuances

- Experience with A/B testing funnels and conversion rate optimization

- Snapshot or template experience (if you've built GHL snapshots for agencies, tell us)



What It's Like Working With Us:



- We're a small, fast-moving team. No corporate bureaucracy.

- We give clear direction and expect ownership. You won't be micromanaged, but you will be accountable.

- We use Loom, Slack/chat, and project management tools to stay aligned.

- There's real growth opportunity here — if you crush it, this becomes a long-term role with increasing responsibility and pay.



To Apply — READ THIS CAREFULLY:



We get a lot of applications. To make sure you actually read this post, please do the following:



1. Start your application with the word **"BLUEPRINT"** so we know you read the full posting.

2. Send a brief Loom video (2–3 minutes max) walking us through ONE GoHighLevel account you've built or worked on. Show us the workflows, pipelines, or funnels you set up. Blur or hide any confidential info — we just want to see your work.

3. List the top 3 GHL features you're most proficient in.

4. Tell us your available hours and timezone.



Do NOT send a generic application. We will ignore it.
