title: BIM Manager (Australian Building Services)
description:
I am looking for an experienced BIM Manager who can help manage my business. You will work closely with engineers across multiple projects, ensuring all BIM models and documentation meet Australian Standards and client requirements while maintaining exceptional quality throughout the project lifecycle.



Please send your CV and portfolio and answer the following:

1) How long have you been a BIM Manager?

2) Have you worked with Australian Based clients?

3) How long have you used Revit?



Requirements:

• Proven experience as a BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or Building Services Revit Technician.

• Previous experience working with Australian clients or engineering consultancies.

• Expert in Autodesk Revit and multidisciplinary BIM coordination.

• Strong understanding of Mechanical, Hydraulic, Electrical, and Fire building services.

• Experience with clash detection, tender documentation, and construction documentation.

• Knowledge of Australian Standards and BIM workflows.

• Familiarity with AutoCAD.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects.



Key Responsibilities:

• Create, develop, and maintain multidisciplinary Revit BIM models across Mechanical, Hydraulic, Electrical, and Fire services.

• Coordinate BIM models across disciplines and perform clash detection to identify and resolve design conflicts.

• Produce accurate Revit documentation, schedules, drawing packages, and construction documentation for Australian projects.

• Maintain BIM standards, model quality, revision control, and documentation consistency throughout all project stages.

• Collaborate with engineers and project teams to ensure models accurately reflect design intent and project requirements.

• Support the preparation of tender and construction documentation packages.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work.

• Provide occasional AutoCAD support for 2D documentation when required.

• Ensure all deliverables comply with Australian Standards, BIM protocols, and client-specific requirements.

• Assist engineering teams throughout the design, documentation, and construction phases.

title: SHORT-FORM CONTENT & PUBLISHING ASSISTANT
description:
Part-Time Remote Position – Philippines



We are looking for an organised, creative and reliable person to help us turn our existing long-form travel videos into short-form content and ensure that content is consistently scheduled and published across all major platforms.



This is not a social media strategy role and it is not a traditional full-time video-editor position.



The main focus is execution:



Finding strong 
nts within existing videos.

Turning them into engaging Shorts and Reels.

Preparing captions and titles.

Organising everything inside Notion.

Scheduling content consistently across multiple platforms.

Making sure no useful content is wasted.



You should be comfortable using CapCut and understand what makes people stop scrolling and continue watching.



What You’ll Be Doing

Short-Form Content Creation

Review existing long-form YouTube videos and other recorded content.

Identify interesting, useful, funny, controversial or attention-grabbing 
nts.

Turn these 
nts into short vertical videos for:

YouTube Shorts

Instagram Reels

 Reels

TikTok

Create clean, engaging edits using CapCut.

Add accurate subtitles and on-screen text.

Create strong opening hooks.

Remove pauses, dead space and unnecessary sections.

Improve pacing while keeping the speaker’s natural personality.

Resize and format content correctly for each platform.

Use approved branding, fonts and templates.

Repurpose older videos that still contain valuable content.

Create several short-form pieces from one long-form video where possible.

Content Scheduling and Publishing

Upload and schedule approved content across all agreed platforms.

Prepare suitable titles, descriptions, captions and hashtags.

Adjust captions where necessary for each platform.

Make sure links, tags, locations and mentions are correct.

Check that scheduled posts have published correctly.

Maintain a consistent publishing schedule.

Repost or repurpose suitable content when appropriate.

Keep track of which clips have already been used to avoid unnecessary duplication.

Notion and Content Organisation

Manage the short-form content calendar inside Notion.

Keep each piece of content updated with the correct status, such as:

To review

To edit

Awaiting approval

Approved

Scheduled

Published

Add publishing dates, platforms, captions and links.

Keep video files, exports and project folders properly organised.

Use clear naming systems so that content can be found quickly.

Maintain a library of completed and reusable short-form content.

Provide a clear weekly overview of what has been created, approved and scheduled.

What This Role Is Not



This is not primarily a role for:



Designing Canva posts.

Building complete social media strategies.

Managing paid advertising.

Producing complicated cinematic videos.

Adding excessive effects, transitions or animations.

Simply running every video through an AI clipping tool and posting the results without reviewing them.



AI tools may be used to speed up the process, but every clip must still be manually checked, improved and made suitable for our audience.



You Must Be

Highly organised.

Confident using CapCut.

Experienced creating vertical short-form videos.

Able to recognise the strongest 
nts within a longer video.

Able to create a strong opening hook.

Comfortable adding subtitles and on-screen text.

Able to follow an existing brand style.

Familiar with Notion or able to learn it quickly.

Reliable with schedules and deadlines.

Able to work independently without constant supervision.

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and making revisions.

Able to produce content efficiently without sacrificing quality.

Strong in written English.

Careful with spelling, captions and factual accuracy.

Interested in travel, tourism, news or entertainment content.

Ideal Experience



The following would be strong advantages:



CapCut Desktop.

YouTube Shorts.

Instagram Reels.

 Reels.

TikTok.

Notion content calendars.

Meta Business Suite.

YouTube Studio.

Scheduling platforms.

Travel or tourism content.

Repurposing podcasts, interviews or long-form YouTube videos.

Creating subtitles and attention-grabbing hooks.

Basic thumbnail or cover-image creation.

What Good Work Looks Like

The opening seconds immediately create interest.

The video gets to the point quickly.

Subtitles are accurate and easy to read.

The editing feels natural rather than overproduced.

title: HR & Operations Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

The HR & Operations  Coordinator plays a vital, fast-paced, and multi-disciplinary role in our central team. This role is the heartbeat of our daily operations, split between two critical areas: finding the best talent and masterfully coordinating our care schedules.



You will be responsible for the entire candidate journey—from advertising and screening to interviewing and onboarding—while simultaneously managing and optimizing our care rotas.



This is a highly demanding, fast-paced role that requires a dedicated, resilient, and critical thinker. You must be exceptionally organized, confident on the phone, and possess the ability to negotiate and balance varying interests (matching client needs with carer availability) without breaking a sweat.



Essential Functions

1. Care Coordination & Dynamic Scheduling 

Rota Creation & Management: Designing, building, and maintaining weekly and monthly rotas for our care teams using our scheduling software.



Dynamic Shift Coverage: Proactively managing unexpected staff absences, sickness, or emergency changes. You will need to logically move staff from one part of the rota to another seamlessly, ensuring service delivery is never compromised.



Rota Ownership: Taking absolute accountability for the schedule. You are someone who refuses to "abandon ship" or log off leaving a critical shift uncovered without a resolved plan.



Conflict & Interest Management: Balancing the preferences and contracted hours of our carers with the precise needs of our service users, resolving scheduling conflicts with diplomacy and firmness.



2. Recruitment & HR

Talent Attraction: Writing and posting engaging job adverts across various online platforms and managing applicant pools.



Screening & Interviewing: Conducting efficient, warm, and thorough phone and video screenings to filter for high-quality, compassionate carers.



Onboarding & Compliance: Guiding successful candidates through the onboarding pipeline, coordinating training, and ensuring they are fully prepared for their first shadow shift.



3. Compliance & Administration

Audit Readiness: Managing and auditing personnel files to ensure 100% compliance.



Due Diligence: Conducting and chasing reference checks, Right to Work documentation, and DBS (criminal record) checks with urgency.



Communication Hub: Acting as a primary, highly professional point of contact for carers regarding their schedules, queries, and basic HR needs.



Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

A "Systems & Puzzle" Thinker: You can look at a complex, changing schedule and logically understand how moving Carer A to Shift B affects the rest of the week. You spot process improvements naturally.



A strong work ethic with a "finish the job" attitude. You take pride in delivering seamless care and do not leave tasks half-done.



Exceptional Phone Confidence: You are highly articulate, persuasive, and comfortable making frequent phone calls to negotiate shifts, deliver feedback, or interview candidates.



Resilience & Stress Tolerance: You thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment where priorities can change in an instant.



Advanced Computer Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (particularly Excel for data tracking, Word, and) and quick to learn scheduling/rostering software.



Outstanding Communication: Fluent, professional written and spoken English. You can de-escalate tense situations and align different personalities toward a common goal.



Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.



At least 1–2 years of experience in recruitment, human resources, or care coordination/scheduling (experience in the UK health and social care sector is highly preferred).



Proven experience working in a fast-paced environment handling complex administrative workflows.



How to Apply

As part of your application, please send a short video of up to two minutes introducing yourself, outlining your experience with dynamic scheduling or coordination, and explaining why you want to work in the care sector to:

title: Junior IT Support Executive
description:
About KLME LLP

KLME LLP is a multi-jurisdictional law firm operating across the UAE (including ADGM and DIFC) and the wider region, supporting a diverse client base spanning legal, compliance, and corporate advisory work. The firm is modernising its back-office operations — building an integrated Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environment supported by AI tools (Claude) — to make document management, compliance tracking, and client administration faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.



The Role

KLME is looking for an IT Support Executive to join the Operations/Admin team. You will take ownership of the firm's SharePoint structure, Microsoft 365 administration, and day-to-day IT support — and will work closely with the Managing Partner and Operations team to embed Claude (our AI assistant) into everyday workflows across Compliance, Finance, and the wider firm.



This is a genuine ground-floor opportunity: you'll be helping design and build the firm's information architecture from scratch, with direct exposure to the Managing Partner and real ownership of the systems you set up.



Key Responsibilities

SharePoint & Microsoft 365 Administration

Build and maintain the firm's SharePoint structure (Lawyers, Compliance, Finance folders) in line with agreed client/matter naming conventions.

Set up new client and matter folders when new matters are opened, ensuring correct folder structure, naming, and permissions.

Maintain the central "master mapping" list of short client codes, client IDs, and matter IDs.

Manage document and folder access permissions for lawyers and support staff across OneDrive and SharePoint.



 & Systems Administration

Set up and manage shared mailboxes (e.g. Compliance, Finance, IT/Cybersecurity) and their aliases, migrating away from distribution lists where appropriate.

Support the firm-wide rollout of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and help troubleshoot related access issues.

Provide general Microsoft 365 administration: user account setup, Outlook/OneDrive configuration, and device provisioning (e.g. work mobiles).



AI / Claude Support

Act as a first point of contact for staff questions on using Claude alongside the firm's Microsoft 365 data.

Help keep SharePoint and OneDrive data structured and up to date so Claude and other AI tools can search and retrieve it accurately.

Support the drafting and roll-out of the firm's AI Use Policy and related governance documents.



IT & Cybersecurity Support

Support the firm's file lockdown checklist and wider access-control rollout.

Act as the first point of contact for general IT queries and troubleshooting across the firm.



Document & Records Management

Support roll-out of the firm's document filing and naming policy and SharePoint/OneDrive usage policy.

Maintain the central library of current templates (letters of engagement, terms of business, policies) so lawyers always use the latest approved version.

Track expiry of key documents (trade licences, IDs, KYC/AML documents) and flag upcoming renewals.



General Administrative Support

Provide wider administrative and back-office support to the Operations team as needed.



About You



Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook and Teams.

A genuine interest in, and ideally hands-on experience with, AI tools such as Claude — this is a core requirement of the role, not a bonus.

High attention to detail and comfortable working to strict file-naming and folder conventions.

Good communication skills; confident liaising with lawyers, consultants, and external stakeholders.

Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential and sensitive client data.

Basic awareness of cybersecurity practices (e.g. MFA, access management) — full training will be provided.

Based in the UAE, or eligible to work in the UAE.



Nice to have

Familiarity with a practice/matter management system (e.g. Lexzur or similar) — not essential, full training given.

Exposure to compliance or AML concepts.



What We Offer

A genuine ground-floor opportunity to help build a modern, AI-integrated back office from scratch.

Direct mentorship and exposure to the Managing Partner and senior Operations team.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint architecture, and enterprise AI tools (Claude).

Scope for the role to grow as the firm's technology and AI adoption expands.



How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short covering note to [recruitment contact /
] with the subject line "IT Support Executive Application."

 and live-chat platforms

Sales-minded as well as service-focused.

Expedia, Agoda,

Sales or lead-generation experience.

title: Senior Mobile Developer (React Native + Flutter)
description:
Job Title: Senior Mobile Developer (React Native + Flutter)



About the Role

We are looking for a high-impact Senior Mobile Developer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of our cross-platform mobile applications. In this role, you will leverage your deep expertise in React Native and Flutter to build high-performance, scalable, and user-centric mobile experiences for both iOS and Android. You will be a key technical leader, driving architectural decisions, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating closely with product, design, and backend teams to ship world-class products.



Key Responsibilities



· Design & Development: Design, build, and maintain high-quality, cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Flutter.

· Architecture & Leadership: Lead architecture and technical decisions across mobile platforms, ensuring scalable, maintainable, and robust codebases.

· Performance Optimization: Stay deeply hands-on with coding, debugging, and performance optimization to ensure smooth, responsive, and reliable applications.

· Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with UI/UX designers, backend engineers, and product managers to translate designs and requirements into seamless, end-to-end features.

· Integrations: Integrate RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, third-party SDKs, authentication systems, push notifications, and payment gateways.

· Code Quality & Mentorship: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Participate in code reviews, enforce best practices, and mentor junior developers through pairing and technical guidance.

· Deployment: Ensure applications meet App Store and Google Play Store guidelines and manage the deployment process.



Required Qualifications



· Experience: 5+ years of professional mobile development experience.

· Technical Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with both React Native and Flutter.

· Architecture: Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture).

· API Integration: Proven experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services.

· Native Knowledge: A solid understanding of native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) internals to build custom modules and optimize platform-specific features.

· State Management: Proficiency with state management solutions (e.g., Redux, Provider, Bloc).

· UI/UX: Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices and the ability to translate designs into responsive, high-performance code.

· Version Control: Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.



Preferred Qualifications



· Published Apps: A proven portfolio of applications published on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

· CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for mobile applications.

· Backend & Cloud: Familiarity with backend services like Firebase, Supabase, or AWS.

· AI Integration: Experience integrating AI capabilities (e.g., OpenAI, Claude APIs) or using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor).

· Product Mindset: A product-focused perspective with the ability to take ownership of features from development to deployment.



Nice-to-Haves



· Experience with real-time features (WebSockets).

· Knowledge of payment gateway integration.

· Familiarity with GraphQL.

· Experience with health tech, wearables, or Bluetooth integrations.



What We Offer



· Competitive salary and benefits package.

· Opportunity to work on impactful, high-growth mobile products.

· A collaborative, fast-moving, and remote-friendly team environment.

· A culture that values technical excellence, clean code, and continuous learning.

Credit Dispute Specialist (FCRA & DisputeFox Experience Preferred)



We're a growing U.S.-based credit consulting company looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our team long-term.



We're looking for someone who understands consumer credit reporting, the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Metro 2 compliance, and factual dispute strategies. This is not a position for someone who relies on identity theft or fraud-based dispute methods.



Responsibilities



* Review consumer credit reports from all three bureaus.

* Analyze accounts and determine the strongest factual dispute strategy.

* Prepare dispute letters using FCRA laws and consumer protection regulations.

* Process dispute rounds inside DisputeFox (preferred).

* Maintain accurate client records and documentation.

* Review investigation results and determine next-step strategies.

* Ensure disputes remain compliant and professional.



Requirements



* Previous experience in the credit repair industry.

* Strong understanding of the FCRA (especially dispute-related sections).

* Experience with factual dispute strategies.

* Familiarity with Metro 2 reporting standards.

* Excellent written English.

* High attention to detail.

* Organized and able to manage multiple client files.

* Experience with DisputeFox is preferred but not required if you have strong industry experience.



NOT a Fit If You:



* Use identity theft or fraud tactics to remove accounts.

* Submit the same dispute letter to every client.

* Guess instead of researching applicable laws.

* Cut corners or use non-compliant practices.



What We're Looking For



We're building a long-term team and want someone who genuinely enjoys helping consumers improve their credit through accurate, compliant, and well-researched dispute strategies. We value quality over speed and are always looking to improve our systems and processes.



To Apply

1. How many years have you worked in credit repair?

2. What credit repair software have you used?

3. Which sections of the FCRA are you most familiar with?

My goal is to focus primarily on what only I can do:



* Develop original ideas and perspectives

* Share my financial knowledge and personal experiences

* Record original talking-head content

* Be the face and voice of the brand



Your role will be to help turn those ideas and original content into a larger, consistent content ecosystem—and help manage the day-to-day execution required to grow the brand.



About the Brand



The content focuses primarily on:



* Personal finance

* Investing

* Financial independence and FIRE

* Building wealth

* Financial freedom

* Money psychology and financial habits

* Becoming work-optional



The core philosophy behind the brand is:



“The goal isn’t to become rich. The goal is to become free.”



The content is educational, conversational, practical, and designed to make financial concepts easier for everyday people to understand.



How We Will Work Together



I will primarily be responsible for:



* Providing the core ideas, opinions, and subject-matter expertise

* Recording original talking-head videos

* Sharing personal stories and experiences

* Approving sensitive or technical financial information

* Providing overall brand direction



You will help turn that foundation into a consistent, high-volume content system.



The goal is not for me to provide you with a detailed daily checklist forever.



Initially, I will provide guidance, examples, templates, and feedback. Over time, I am looking for someone who can become increasingly independent and proactive as they learn the brand.



Your Responsibilities



1. Content Creation



Create short-form content using approved ideas, existing content, audience questions, and other available source material.



This may include:



* Faceless short-form Reels

* Text-on-screen Reels

* B-roll-based videos

* Simple educational videos

* Static posts

* Polls

* Carousels

* Quote or insight-based content

* Content variations for testing

* Canva

* CapCut

* Edits

* Or similar content creation tools



2. Content Repurposing



One of the most important parts of this role will be identifying multiple content opportunities from a single original idea.



For example, one original talking-head video may contain:



* A strong quote

* A financial lesson

* A myth or misconception

* A numerical example

* A question for the audience

* A follow-up topic

* A potential poll

* A faceless Reel concept

* A carousel idea



Your job will be to identify these opportunities and turn approved ideas into additional content.



Repurposing does not mean simply reposting the same video repeatedly.



It means finding new ways to communicate, expand, test, and distribute the underlying ideas.



3. Publishing and Distribution



Help manage the publishing of content across:



* Instagram

*

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts



Responsibilities may include:



* Scheduling and/or publishing approved content

* Adapting captions or formatting where necessary for different platforms

* Maintaining an organized content calendar

* Keeping track of what has been posted and where

* Organizing finished content and source materials

* Maintaining a consistent publishing schedule



4. Community Management



Help manage routine audience engagement by:



* Monitoring comments

* Responding to appropriate routine comments in the brand’s voice

* Flagging comments that require my personal response

* Flagging technical, sensitive, controversial, or personalized financial questions

* Identifying recurring audience questions

* Turning useful audience questions and comments into potential future content ideas



You must never provide personalized financial or investment advice on my behalf.



When uncertain about how to respond, you should flag the comment rather than guess.



5. Content Research and Ideation



You will be expected to proactively look for content opportunities by:



* Reviewing audience comments and questions

* Reviewing previously successful content

* Identifying recurring audience pain points

* Monitoring relevant social media trends

* Studying successful educational content formats

* Suggesting new hooks and angles

* Identifying opportunities to create follow-up content

* Researching relevant topics when requested



The goal is for you to gradually become someone who brings ideas to the table—not someone who waits for instructions every day.



6. Performance Tracking



Help track basic content performance, including relevant metrics such as:



* Views

* Reach

* Watch time or retention when available

* Shares

* Saves

* Comments

* Follower growth



You should help identify patterns such as:



* Which topics perform best

* Which hooks perform best

* Which formats perform best

* Which content generates the most discussion

* Which posts should be expanded into follow-up content



A simple weekly performance summary may be required.



The Ideal Candidate



You:



* Understand Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

* Have experience creating short-form social media content

* Understand hooks and attention

* Can create engaging faceless and text-on-screen content

* Have strong written English

* Can write clear, compelling captions and calls to action

* Understand basic content repurposing

* Have good visual judgment

* Are highly organized

* Can follow instructions carefully

* Can work independently once expectations are clear

* Are proactive and resourceful

* Are comfortable using AI tools responsibly to improve productivity

* Are willing to learn a specific brand voice

* Understand that financial content requires accuracy

* Are interested in a long-term working relationship



Experience with personal finance, investing, business, or educational content is an advantage, but it is not required.



Important: Financial Accuracy



This is a personal finance brand.



You do not need to be a financial expert.



However, you must never:



* Invent financial facts

* Invent statistics

* Change financial numbers

* Make unsupported investment claims

* Give personalized financial advice on my behalf



When you are uncertain, ask.



Accuracy is more important than pretending to know the answer.



Compensation Structure



This role will not be paid primarily by the hour.



I am looking for a deliverable-based working arrangement that provides clear expectations and predictable compensation for both sides.



The position will begin with a paid trial period.



During the trial, we will evaluate:



* Content quality

* Creativity

* Reliability

* Communication

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Understanding of the brand

* Speed and efficiency

* Ability to generate useful ideas



After a successful trial, the goal is to move to a fixed monthly package covering an agreed scope of work.



The monthly package may include an agreed combination of:



* A specific number of original faceless or text-on-screen short-form content pieces

* Content repurposing

* Static posts and/or carousels

* Publishing and scheduling

* Routine community management

* Content organization

* Weekly content ideation

* Basic performance tracking and reporting



The exact monthly deliverables and compensation will be agreed upon before the ongoing arrangement begins.



Important



I am looking for someone who values consistent, long-term work.



As the brand grows and the working relationship develops, there may be opportunities for:



* Increased responsibility

* Increased monthly compensation

* Performance-based bonuses

* Additional content volume

* A larger role in the overall content operation



Long-Term Vision



I am not looking for someone to complete a few isolated tasks.



I am looking for someone who can potentially become an important part of the growth of this brand.



Over time, I want to be able to focus primarily on:



Thinking ? Creating ? Recording ? Approving



While you increasingly help manage:



Repurposing ? Creating ? Publishing ? Engaging ? Tracking ? Learning



The right person will become increasingly independent as they learn the brand, audience, content strategy, and systems.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



FINANCIAL FREEDOM



This helps me identify candidates who carefully read instructions.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with social media content creation and management.

3. Links or examples of content you have personally created.

4. Which parts of those examples you personally completed.

5. The platforms you understand best.

6. The tools you use for content creation and social media management.

7. Your availability.

8. How many short-form content pieces you could realistically create per week.

9. Your experience with community management.

10. Your experience using AI tools for content creation or productivity.

11. Your expected compensation for an ongoing deliverable-based monthly arrangement.



Application Task



Please provide three short-form content ideas for a personal finance brand built around the philosophy:



“The goal isn’t to become rich. The goal is to become free.”



For each idea, provide:



* The hook

* The content format you would use

* A brief explanation of why you think it could perform well



Repurposing Exercise



Imagine I have created a 60-second talking-head video explaining:



“You do not need $1 million to retire. Your personal financial independence number depends largely on your annual expenses.”



Please explain how you would turn that one original video idea into at least five additional pieces of content.



I am not looking for five reposts of the same video.



I want to see how you think about:



* Different angles

* Different hooks

* Different formats

* Audience engagement

* Follow-up content



Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid trial.



The trial may include:



* Creating one or more short-form content pieces from an approved idea

* Repurposing an existing piece of content

* Writing sample captions or hooks

* Demonstrating how you would organize and publish content

* Providing sample responses to audience comments



The paid trial does not guarantee an ongoing position.



The strongest candidate will be offered the opportunity to discuss a longer-term working arrangement.



What I Value Most



I am not necessarily looking for the person with the longest résumé.



I am looking for someone who is:



Proactive. Creative. Reliable. Organized. Coachable. Curious.



I want someone who can learn the brand, understand the audience, notice opportunities, and gradually require less day-to-day direction.



If you are looking for a long-term opportunity to help build and grow a content brand from the ground up, I would love to hear from you.

title: Short-form video editor for personal finance creator
description:
Remote | Freelance | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



I am looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Editor to work with me on an ongoing basis for a growing personal finance and financial freedom content brand.



This is not a one-time project.



I am looking for someone who can become my long-term video editor and help me build a consistent, efficient content production system.



My goal is to focus primarily on what I do best:



Developing ideas, sharing my expertise, and recording content.



Your role will be to take my raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging, platform-ready short-form videos.



About the Brand



The brand focuses on:



* Personal finance

* Investing

* Financial independence and FIRE

* Building wealth

* Money psychology and financial habits

* Creating financial freedom

* Becoming work-optional



The core philosophy behind the brand is:



“The goal isn’t to become rich. The goal is to become free.”



The content is educational, conversational, practical, and designed to make financial concepts easier for everyday people to understand.



What You Will Be Editing



Most videos will be:



* Talking-head videos

* Approximately 30 seconds to 2 minutes long

* Vertical 9:16 format

* Created for Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



I will provide the raw footage.



Depending on the video, I may also provide:



* Screen recordings

* Screenshots

* Images

* Charts

* Other supporting visual assets



The same completed video may be published across multiple social media platforms.



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for turning raw footage into a polished final video.



Depending on the complexity of the video, this may include:



* Removing mistakes, unnecessary pauses, and dead space

* Tightening the pacing while keeping the speaker sounding natural

* Adding clean, accurate, easy-to-read captions

* Highlighting important words and phrases

* Adding subtle zooms and punch-ins where appropriate

* Adding relevant B-roll that supports what is being discussed

* Sourcing appropriate B-roll when required

* Adding screenshots, screen recordings, charts, or images where appropriate

* Adding simple visual effects or graphics when they improve understanding

* Adding appropriate sound effects where they genuinely improve the video

* Adding background music when appropriate

* Basic audio cleanup and volume balancing

* Following the established visual identity and editing style of the brand

* Exporting the final video in the correct high-quality vertical format



Editing Style



I am not looking for chaotic editing, excessive transitions, or unnecessary effects.



The editing should:



* Help hold the viewer’s attention

* Support the message rather than distract from it

* Keep the creator’s personality natural

* Make financial concepts easier to understand

* Use B-roll intentionally

* Feel polished, modern, and engaging

* Maintain a consistent visual identity across videos



The goal is not to add an effect every second.



The goal is to make a strong piece of content even stronger.



Types of Edits



Not every video will require the same amount of work.



Basic Edit



A basic edit may include:



* Removing mistakes and unnecessary pauses

* Tightening pacing

* Basic audio cleanup

* Accurate captions

* Simple zooms or punch-ins

* Final vertical export



Standard Edit



A standard edit may include:



* Everything included in a basic edit

* Sourcing and adding relevant B-roll

* Screenshots or screen recordings

* More frequent visual changes

* Branded caption styling

* Simple graphics

* Appropriate sound effects

* Background music where appropriate



Complex Edit



Some videos may occasionally require:



* Significant custom graphics

* More advanced animation

* Complex financial visuals

* Extensive screen recordings

* Significant audio repair

* Unusually time-intensive editing



Complex edits will be discussed and priced separately before work begins.



Compensation



This is primarily a per-project / per-finished-video position, not an hourly position.



Compensation will be based on the length and complexity of the completed video.



As a general starting range:



* Basic short-form editing: approximately CAD $3 per finished minute

* Standard editing requiring captions, B-roll, visual changes, and branded formatting: approximately CAD $5–$7 per finished minute

* Complex edits: agreed upon separately before work begins



Most videos will be approximately 30 seconds to 2 minutes long.



For example:



* A 60-second basic edit may pay approximately CAD $3

* A 60-second standard edit may pay approximately CAD $5–$7

* A 2-minute standard edit may pay approximately CAD $10–$14



The exact rate for each type of work will be agreed upon in advance.



Long-Term and High-Volume Opportunity



I am not looking for someone to edit one or two videos.



I am building a long-term content brand and expect to produce content consistently.



The right editor may eventually receive approximately 20–30 or more short-form videos per month, depending on my recording schedule, content strategy, performance, and the quality of our working relationship.



Because I am looking for consistent, ongoing work, I am particularly interested in editors who value:



* Predictable work

* Long-term client relationships

* Clear expectations

* Consistent communication

* Opportunities to grow with a brand



Once we have established a successful working relationship and understand the typical workload, I may be open to discussing a fixed monthly package for an agreed number of videos.



However, the position will begin on a per-video basis.



Revisions



The agreed editing rate will include up to two reasonable rounds of revisions.



A revision means adjustments to the agreed edit, such as:



* Correcting captions

* Replacing B-roll

* Adjusting pacing

* Changing a visual element

* Making reasonable stylistic corrections



A complete change in creative direction after the original instructions were followed correctly may be considered a new edit or require additional compensation.



My goal is to develop a clear editing system and brand guide so that the number of revisions decreases significantly over time.



Turnaround Time



Please tell me your realistic turnaround time when applying.



Reliability is extremely important.



I would rather work with an editor who consistently delivers excellent work when promised than someone who promises unrealistic turnaround times and misses deadlines.



The Ideal Candidate



You:



* Have experience editing short-form vertical video

* Understand Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Understand pacing and viewer retention

* Know how to edit talking-head content without making it feel unnatural

* Can create clean, accurate captions

* Know when and where to use B-roll

* Can source relevant B-roll independently

* Have good visual judgment

* Have strong attention to detail

* Can follow an established brand style

* Communicate clearly

* Meet agreed deadlines

* Are comfortable receiving constructive feedback

* Do not repeatedly make the same mistakes after receiving feedback

* Are interested in a long-term working relationship



You may use:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* Descript

* Or another professional editing platform



I care more about the quality of the finished work than which software you use.



Important: Financial Content Requires Accuracy



This is a personal finance brand.



You are not expected to be a financial expert.



However, captions, numbers, screenshots, and financial terminology must be represented accurately.



You must not change financial statements, numbers, or terminology simply because you think another version sounds better.



If you are uncertain about something, ask.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



I READ EVERYTHING



This helps me identify candidates who carefully read instructions.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. How long you have been editing short-form videos.

3. Three to five examples of short-form videos that you personally edited.

4. Which parts of those examples you personally completed.

5. The editing software you use.

6. Your realistic turnaround time for a 60-second talking-head video.

7. Your current availability.

8. Approximately how many short-form videos you could realistically edit per week.

9. Whether you are comfortable with the compensation structure described above.

10. Your internet speed and computer specifications.



Please do not send examples of work that you did not personally edit.



Paid Editing Test



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



Multiple shortlisted candidates may receive the same raw footage and the same instructions.



The purpose of the test is to evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Creative judgment

* Choice of B-roll

* Caption accuracy

* Pacing

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions

* Communication

* Turnaround time



The paid test does not guarantee ongoing employment.



The strongest candidate will be offered ongoing work.



What I Value Most



I am not necessarily looking for the person with the longest résumé.



I am looking for someone who is:



Reliable. Creative. Coachable. Consistent. Detail-oriented.



I want to build a working relationship where, over time, you understand the brand so well that I can send you raw footage and trust you to turn it into a strong finished video with minimal direction.



If you are looking for consistent, long-term editing work and believe you can help build a growing content brand, I would love to see your work.

The content will be based on clips from podcasts, livestreams, sports, boxing, MMA, and internet personalities. The editor must know how to transform the clips by adding narration, commentary, captions, visual effects, and creative editing.

This position may become ongoing work for the right person.

title: Digital Marketing Expert- Funnel Builder & GHL Specialist (Full time)
description:
We’re looking for someone who can think like a CMO but execute like a top-tier copywriter and funnel builder.



This isn’t a role for a corporate strategist or agency manager. 

This is a builder’s role. 

You’ll be the second half of a tight marketing unit. The Founder is the voice and face of the brand. A social media manager handles scheduling and managing posting content on all social channels, drives organic growth, builds engagement, grows the
 list, executes campaigns, and tracks performance—using AI tools and trend-driven strategies to expand brand reach and convert followers into high-ticket clients. The Video Editor produces high-converting long-form and viral short-form video content using AI tools, storytelling, and trend-driven techniques to boost engagement, retention, and conversions—working closely with you and Social Media Manager to maintain brand consistency and performance.





YOU RUN EVERYTHING ELSE

-You build the funnels.

-You manage video editors for video content.

-You pull the levers.

-And you scale the machine.





If you’re someone who loves to own the entire customer journey, thinks in terms of offers and outcomes, and thrives on building lean, fast-moving campaigns that drive real revenue—this might be your perfect fit.





THE COMPANY

We’re a men’s high level coaching company that helps husbands and fathers restore their leadership, rebuild their homes, and reignite attraction in their marriages. Our programs are built on ancient wisdom, tested frameworks, and deep results. Our clients are hungry for transformation—and we deliver.

We’re backed by a Christian founder. We’re a ground floor opportunity. And we’re ready to launch and scale.





Note:  Please make sure to review the video and link before applying

Video link: 

Company - ONE PAGER: 





WHAT YOU WILL DO (90% of Your Time):

-Build: Funnels, lead magnets, nurture sequences, retargeting ads, checkout flows.

-Test: Headlines, CTAs, hooks, offers, pricing structures, sales scripts.

-Analyze: Competitive market analysis, Campaign performance, ad spend ROI, funnel metrics, retention data.

-Optimize: Funnels, conversions, lead quality,
 engagement, and sales volume.



You’re not handing things off to other departments.

You are the Digital Marketing Department.

And you love it that way.





KEY OUTCOMES YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

-A consistent flow of high-quality sales leads

-Funnels that convert cold traffic profitably

-Compelling messaging across every customer touchpoint

-Offer positioning that drives urgency and demand

-Reporting that tracks what’s working and what’s not





YOU'LL WORK DIRECTLY WITH:

-The Founder – records raw content, defines the mission, and sets the vision.

-Video Editor – edits and formats video content for ads, YouTube, and social.

-Social Media Manager – distributes content, manages comments, and handles community.

-You’ll collaborate—but own the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution.





WHO IS THIS ROLE PERFECT FOR:

-A former successful solopreneur or agency operator who’s tired of juggling 5 clients and wants to go deep on one brand

-A performance marketer who thrives on fast iteration, live feedback, and tracking results in real time

-Someone who can build systems, not just follow them





REQUIREMENTS:

-Proven experience writing high-converting copy 
s, sales pages, VSLs, ads, etc. WITH LARGE SUCCESS)

-Strong understanding of funnels, customer psychology, and direct-response marketing

-Comfortable inside ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel, or similar tools

-Knows how to build pages, write copy, and launch campaigns without waiting for help



Bonus: understands retention marketing, upsell/downsell flows, and backend monetization





This Is NOT For You If:

-You only want to “strategize” but don’t want to build

-You need a big team to get anything done

-You want to “manage creatives” instead of being one

-You aren’t fast, self-directed, or results-driven





What You Get:

Competitive base + performance-based bonus!

Full ownership over marketing strategy and execution

Opportunity to work directly with the founder, who is a seasoned Marketer

Gain additional high level training

Freedom to work remote

A high-integrity team with zero fluff and zero drama

A mission-driven product with real impact and market demand





If you’re the kind of operator who wants to see the direct impact of your work, be a part of a movement that will change the world, take pride in every word you write, and want to build something meaningful with speed and precision—this is your role.

Apply now with samples of your work, proof of performance, and a short note on why this fits you.



This would be a full-time Digital Marketing role to lock arms with our core team and move in sync with our rhythm.





***3 Non-Negotiables to note***

#1 If you are not able to go full-time right now, are you willing to ramp up to full-time?

#2 We only hire long-term. If you’re looking for a quick project or gig, this won’t be the right fit. We’re building legacy, not launching a temp project.

#3 For us to collaborate in real-time, it’s important that you are able to be on scheduled TEAM CALLS between 9am-6pm CST. 

We’re in the trenches daily, pushing hard and moving fast, and we need someone who is present, responsive, and fully immersed in the mission. I also own an investment firm and my time is limited, so when I need to speak to a team member, video calls are paramount for speed and to remove bottlenecks.



To align for expectations:

This is a 160-hour per month role (full-time), and we’re offering $5-8/hr as a starting rate, with strong performance-based bonus incentives. For example, within 12 months, it would be possible to earn an additional $6/hr on top of base pay, based on performance, contribution, and alignment with our vision.



But more than the money, we’re offering something most companies can’t:

A seat at the ground floor of a world-changing movement. A culture where your work directly contributes to transforming broken families, healing marriages, and restoring men to their God-given identity.

If you’re excited by the idea of being a vital part of a team that is storming the gates of hell and setting men free worldwide—while mastering your craft and growing in responsibility—then this may be your calling.

Let me know if this resonates with you. We’d love to explore if this is a divine fit.





What You’re Stepping Into

You’re not joining a company—you’re joining a movement.

A movement that is raising men back to their God-ordained identity. A mission that doesn’t just change timelines—it changes legacies. This is your opportunity to help lead that charge through the most powerful medium of this age: short-form content with eternal purpose.

If you want to be part of a high-performance team on the frontlines of global men’s transformation, this is the place.

title: Sr. Platform Engineer-PH
description:
About the Role



Pandoblox delivers enterprise-quality data platforms to mid-market companies in weeks, not months — a lean team amplified by AI. We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure the entire client-delivery pipeline runs on, and to evolve it so a small team can stand up and operate many concurrent, fully-isolated client environments without scaling headcount.





This is a senior IC role: ~70% hands-on platform/infra/DevOps, 20% architecture & security, 10% reliability. You live in Terraform, GCP IAM, CI/CD, and Cloud Run. The mandate isn't infrastructure for its own sake — it's infrastructure that gets client outcomes shipped faster, safer, and more repeatably.



This role goes deep on infrastructure, not up into the app layer. If you'd rather be shipping product features and UI, this is the wrong seat.



Responsibilities:



In this role you'll get to...



- execute and own the following:

   - IaC (signal-iac)— the Terraform/OpenTofu estate; provision a new client with a one-line flag flip. Every change is a PR with a plan diff; prod applies only through a gated workflow. Build the paved road so the delivery team onboards a client through a safe, gated path, not a ticket to you.

   - GCP multi-tenancy— a two-tier project model with one isolated project per client; physical, per-project isolation enforced by IAM.

   - Runtime isolation at scale— the shared services (signal-agents,signal-mcp, Supabase) serve every client at once, so one client's load can never degrade another: per-tenant quotas, fairness, noisy-neighbor protection.

   - Identity & secrets— the keyless model (Workload Identity Federation, impersonated service accounts). No long-lived keys, no secrets in Git, no path from laptop to prod.

   - CI/CD— GitHub Actions: build-once-promote, OIDC/keyless auth, trunk-based with environment promotion.

   - Observability & cost— SLOs, freshness/failure alerting, evidence-first i
 response, and per-client cost attribution so margin stays visible as clients stack up.

- collaborate with the project team 

- perform other duties or responsibilities  needed by the role



Requirements:



On day one, we'll expect you to...



- have 8+ years of platform / infra / DevOps / SRE, owning cloud architecture end-to-end

- have expertise in  Terraform / OpenTofu — production modules, multi-env, gated apply

- possess deep GCP — IAM & SA design, WIF, Cloud Run, networking, Secret Manager, BigQuery admin

- have strong CI/CD — GitHub Actions (or equivalent), OIDC/keyless, build-once-promote, trunk-based

- have expertise in security & identity judgment — keyless, least-privilege, gated-prod posture you own

- have experience in multi-tenant isolation at both the data and runtime tiers

- provide proactive observability & i
 response — alerting, SLOs, evidence-first debugging, on-call coverage

- be experienced in per-client cost attribution / FinOps instincts

- work with AWS alongside GCP (QuickSight reporting path, Secrets Manager)

- possess a delivery-first mindset: infra right-sized to delivery outcomes, not over-engineered

- have excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties

- be willing to work within US Pacific timezone (8am - 5pm PST, 12AM - 9AM Manila time) or during client hours as required

- be willing to undergo a 90-days probationary period upon initial hire



Required Stack: Terraform/OpenTofu, GCP (Cloud Run, BigQuery, IAM, WIF, Secret Manager), GitHub Actions, Supabase, Vercel,  AWS (Quick, Secrets Manager), Claude (Anthropic API), and modern, opinionated, no legacy click-ops.



These are preferred experiences:



Multi-client/consulting delivery pipelines

- Supabase/Vercel ops

title: AI Engineer (Claude Code / Agentic Development)
description:
Read the whole post before applying. It is written to filter, and the "how to apply" steps are how we know who actually read it.



WHO WE ARE



We are an AI venture studio based in Davao, building and shipping AI-powered software products for the Australian market. Real products, real paying customers. We move fast because agentic development (Claude Code and similar tools) is core to how we build, not a gimmick we bolt on.



THE ROLE



We are hiring an AI Engineer who builds real software with AI. You design and ship AI-powered products and features end to end: orchestrating AI coding agents to build fast, integrating LLMs into production, and deploying and running what you build. You work remotely, with real ownership over what you ship.



This is not a role for someone who has only watched tutorials or built demos. We care about what you have actually shipped and how you build.



HOW WE BUILD



We build with agentic development. You architect the system, spec the work, and direct AI coding agents (Claude Code) to write, test and refactor it, then you review, harden and ship. The skill is not typing code, it is directing AI to produce production-grade software and having the judgment to know when it is right and when it is wrong. If you already build this way, you will fit right in.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build and ship AI-powered products and features end to end

- Integrate Claude / LLM APIs into production: prompt and agent design, structured output, cost and latency control, handling model failure gracefully

- Work across our stack: Next.js / React / TypeScript, FastAPI / Python, PostgreSQL / Supabase

- Own deployment and basic ops for what you build: CI/CD, Docker, cloud hosting

- Move at studio velocity using agentic tools, while keeping quality high



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- You build production software by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent), not hand-coding every line. Show us what you have shipped this way.

- Strong full-stack ability: Next.js / React / TypeScript on the front, Python / FastAPI on the back, PostgreSQL / Supabase.

- Real experience integrating LLM / Claude APIs into products, not tutorials, actual shipped features.

- Comfortable owning deploy and ops: CI/CD, Docker, cloud hosting, environments and secrets.

- Good judgment on architecture and code quality, so you can spot when the AI got it wrong.

- Strong written English and clear async communication.

- Based in the Philippines and able to visit our Davao office occasionally (now and then).



Years of experience matter less to us than what you have actually built. Show us the work.



NICE TO HAVE



Claude Vision / AI pipelines · React Native / Expo · n8n or workflow automation · Stripe billing · Cloudflare R2 · multi-tenant SaaS experience · prior startup or product ownership.



WHY JOIN



- Build real AI products people pay for, not demos or maintenance tickets

- Work at the frontier of how software is actually built now: agentic development

- Real ownership over what you ship, and room to grow as the studio grows

- Full-time, long-term, and on-time monthly pay



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly, it is the filter)



1. Start your message with the exact phrase: I BUILD WITH AGENTS - then, in one sentence, the coolest thing you have built using AI coding tools. If this is missing, we stop reading.

2. Send links to 2 or 3 things you have personally built and shipped, live URLs or GitHub. One line each on what YOU specifically owned. Include your GitHub or LinkedIn.

3. Attach a short screen-share video (3 to 5 minutes) walking through one of your projects and your own repo. We want to see you actually build and navigate a codebase you made, not just describe it.



Generic or copy-pasted applications are obvious and get dropped. Show us your work.

Asset Recovered Team is hiring professional English-speaking Remote Customer Outreach Assistants in the Philippines.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph first and

 for faster processing with hiring manager. Video is a must or audio to hear your level of speaking English.



This position may be a strong fit when you are:



* Great at speaking with people by telephone

* Sales-oriented without being overly aggressive

* Customer-service focused

* Confident speaking English

* Comfortable building trust with skeptical people

* Motivated by performance bonuses and commissions

* Dependable and able to follow a structured process



You do not have to close the claim.



Your job is to reach potential claimants, verify that you are speaking with the correct person, explain the reason for the call, and connect interested claimants with one of our closers.



We provide the power dialer, CRM, calling script, training, and claimant-verification process.



## MULTIPLE WAYS TO EARN



This is a commission-focused position that rewards you throughout the claimant process.



You can earn:



* $1 USD per hour

* Small performance bonuses for qualified calls

* A $10 weekly performance bonus

* 2% commission on the amount Asset Recovered Team receives from successfully completed claims

* Up to $1,000 commission from one high-value completed claim



Your smaller performance bonuses are earned before the claim is completed.



Your larger 2% commission is earned when a claimant you originated successfully completes the process and Asset Recovered Team receives payment.



## SMALL PERFORMANCE BONUSES



You may earn the following:



* **$1 when a closer accepts your live transfer OR when you successfully book a qualified closer appointment**

* **Additional $1 when the closing team confirms that the claimant is qualified**

* **Additional $1 when a booked claimant attends the scheduled appointment**

* **$10 weekly performance bonus** for meeting attendance, calling, CRM-accuracy, and call-quality standards



The first $1 bonus is paid for either an accepted live transfer or a booked appointment. It is not paid twice for the same initial contact.



### Live-Transfer Example



You reach the correct claimant and connect the interested person directly with a closer.



* Accepted live transfer: $1

* Claimant confirmed as qualified: Additional $1

* Total small performance bonuses: $2



If the claimant later completes the recovery process, you also earn the separate 2% completed-claim commission.



### Booked-Appointment Example



You reach the correct claimant and schedule a closer appointment.



* Qualified appointment booked: $1

* Claimant confirmed as qualified: Additional $1

* Claimant attends the scheduled appointment: Additional $1

* Total small performance bonuses: $3



If the claimant later completes the recovery process, you also earn the separate 2% completed-claim commission.



## SUPER BONUS: 2% COMMISSION ON COMPLETED CLAIMS



In addition to your hourly pay and smaller performance bonuses, you will earn:



# 2% OF THE AMOUNT ASSET RECOVERED TEAM ACTUALLY RECEIVES FROM EACH SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED CLAIM YOU ORIGINATE



The commission is calculated using the amount Asset Recovered Team receives, not the claimant’s total recovery.



### Commission Examples



* Asset Recovered Team receives $5,000: You earn $100

* Asset Recovered Team receives $10,000: You earn $200

* Asset Recovered Team receives $15,000: You earn $300

* Asset Recovered Team receives $25,000: You earn $500

* Asset Recovered Team receives $50,000: You earn $1,000



A single high-value completed claim may produce a commission of up to **$1,000**.



## HOW YOUR BONUSES WORK TOGETHER



### Example: Completed Live-Transfer Claim



Asset Recovered Team receives $10,000 from a claim you originated.



You may earn:



* Accepted live transfer: $1

* Confirmed qualified claimant: $1

* 2% completed-claim commission: $200

* Total earnings from that claimant: $202



### Example: Completed Appointment Claim



Asset Recovered Team receives $25,000 from a claim you originated.



You may earn:



* Qualified appointment booked: $1

* Confirmed qualified claimant: $1

* Claimant attends the appointment: $1

* 2% completed-claim commission: $500

* Total earnings from that claimant: $503



### Example: High-Value Completed Claim



Asset Recovered Team receives $50,000 from a claim you originated.



You may earn:



* Small performance bonuses: Up to $3

* 2% completed-claim commission: $1,000

* Total potential earnings from that claimant: Up to $1,003



Completed-claim commissions are paid after Asset Recovered Team receives cleared funds.



Claims may take time to complete. Commissions are not guaranteed. Earnings depend on claimant qualification, successful claim completion, and the amount received by the company.



## POWER DIALER PROVIDED



We provide a power dialer to help you efficiently make **200 or more outbound call attempts during a full eight-hour shift**.



You will not have to manually enter and dial every telephone number.



Our system helps you:



* Move efficiently between calls

* Contact more potential claimants

* Reduce manual dialing time

* Complete live transfers

* Book closer appointments

* Record call results

* Create more opportunities to earn performance bonuses

* Generate more opportunities for completed-claim commissions



We will train you on the power dialer, CRM, script, verification process, live transfers, and appointment scheduling.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be the first point of contact for potential claimants.



Your responsibilities include:



* Make outbound calls using the company power dialer

* Verify that you reached the correct person

* Introduce Asset Recovered Team professionally

* Explain the reason for the call

* Ask basic verification and qualification questions

* Build trust with interested claimants

* Transfer qualified claimants to an available closer

* Book appointments when a live transfer is unavailable

* Follow up with interested claimants

* Enter accurate information into the CRM

* Maintain complete call notes

* Follow the approved script

* Protect confidential claimant information

* Meet assigned call-volume and quality standards



You will not provide legal advice.



You will not be responsible for completing the final sale or closing the claim.



Your role is to identify, verify, and connect qualified claimants with our closing team.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want applicants who are strong in both sales and customer service.



You should be able to:



* Speak English clearly and confidently

* Create a professional first impression

* Listen carefully

* Ask questions naturally

* Explain information in a simple way

* Build trust without pressuring people

* Remain calm when someone is skeptical

* Handle rejection professionally

* Encourage interested claimants to take the next step

* Accurately document every conversation



Previous experience in customer service, sales, appointment setting, call centers, lead qualification, telemarketing, or outbound calling is helpful, but not required.



Training is provided to qualified applicants.



## REQUIRED EQUIPMENT



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A dependable computer

* A quality headset with a clear microphone

* A quiet and professional workspace

* Reliable electricity

We’re looking for a QuickBooks Finance Admin / Bookkeeping Support Virtual Professional to support a growing service business with finance admin, bookkeeping support, invoice tracking, AR/AP follow-up, reporting, and process documentation.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys keeping records clean, building clear trackers, organizing messy information, and helping leadership stay financially informed.



This is not a CFO role, nor a general catch-all admin role. We’re looking for someone who can provide hands-on finance operations support, help make recurring finance work more visible, and improve repeatable processes over time.



What You’ll Do

You may help with tasks such as:

• Support QuickBooks Online or similar accounting tools

• Track invoices, payments, receipts, payables, receivables, reimbursements, and vendor records

• Assist with bank and credit card reconciliation support

• Help organize transaction records, supporting documents, PDFs, receipts, and invoices

• Support AR/AP tracking and follow-up

• Help monitor commercial invoicing and payment status

• Prepare simple financial trackers, reports, summaries, and leadership updates

• Spot missing information, duplicate entries, inconsistent categories, and reporting gaps

• Organize finance-related files, folders, and documentation

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, templates, and recurring task lists

• Communicate updates, blockers, and completed work clearly

• Use AI tools responsibly to help organize notes, draft summaries, improve documentation, and simplify recurring workflows



Tools You May Work With

Experience with these tools is a plus, but you do not need to have experience with all of them:

• QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software

• Google Sheets or Excel

• Google Workspace

• Asana or similar project management tools

• Jobber or similar service-business platforms

• Slack or similar communication tools

• AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

We are more interested in someone who is accurate, organized, reliable, and comfortable learning systems than someone who has already used every tool.



You May Be a Great Fit If You Are

• Detail-oriented and careful with numbers

• Comfortable with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting tools

• Experienced with invoice tracking, AP/AR support, reconciliation support, or financial admin tasks

• Strong with Google Sheets or Excel for trackers, formulas, organized data, and reporting

• Good at spotting errors, missing details, duplicate entries, or inconsistencies

• Clear in written English communication

• Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently

• Comfortable asking questions when information is unclear

• Able to handle confidential financial and business information carefully

• Organized enough to turn recurring tasks into checklists, SOPs, trackers, or templates

• Open to using AI responsibly to improve documentation, summaries, and workflow organization



Preferred Experience

Any experience in the following areas is a plus:

• QuickBooks Online cleanup, categorization, reconciliation support, or reporting

• Accounts payable and accounts receivable support

• Invoice tracking, payment tracking, or vendor management

• Bookkeeping support for a small business or service-based business

• Financial reports, KPI trackers, dashboards, or management summaries

• SOP creation, process documentation, checklists, or workflow mapping

• Project management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, 
, Notion, or Airtable

• Remote work experience supporting a US-based client, company, or team

• Using AI tools to improve admin, finance, reporting, documentation, or research workflows



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements

To ensure a reliable remote setup, applicants must have:

• Reliable laptop or desktop computer

• Stable internet connection with backup connection

• Webcam, microphone, and headset

• Ability to provide device specs and internet speed test if requested



Why You’ll Love Working With Us

• Paid holidays and PTO

• HMO after your first year

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG and referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions

• Supportive remote work community

• Opportunity to build a meaningful long-term career



To Apply

Please send your updated resume and answer the following questions:

• Tell us briefly about your finance, bookkeeping support, admin, or operations experience.

• What accounting, finance, spreadsheet, or project management tools have you used before?

• Have you used QuickBooks Online or a similar accounting tool? If yes, what tasks have you handled directly?.

• Have you worked remotely with a US-based client, company, or team before? If yes, briefly describe your role and how you communicated with them.

• Have you used AI tools at work? If yes, share one example of how you used AI to organize information, save time, improve documentation, or create a better workflow.

• Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role?



Applications with clear, specific answers will be prioritized. We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate real examples of financial/administrative accuracy, QuickBooks or bookkeeping support, systems thinking, responsible AI use, and proactive communication.



Don’t just look for a job — build a meaningful career with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.

Apply today.

title: Ecommerce Operations Manager (Part-time, Remote)
description:
Ecommerce Operations Manager (Part-time, Remote)

~20 hrs/week · Remote (async-first)



About Us

We're a lean, fast-moving DTC brand in outdoor sports equipment, selling across North America and Europe with a highly seasonal Q4 peak and a small, tight-knit remote team.



We're growing fast and the founder currently handles too much day-to-day operations. That's where you come in.

The Role

You'll be the operational backbone of the business, keeping the shop running smoothly, the customer support team on track, and order issues resolved without the founder needing to be in the loop for every decision.



This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who works autonomously. You'll manage Shopify, oversee our customer support team, and keep our payment and logistics processes running without needing hand-holding.



Trust is everything in this role. You'll have access to our store, payment flows, and team, and we don't take that lightly. We're looking for someone who is straightforward, consistent, and earns trust through their actions over time. If that's how you operate, we'll be a great fit. If you need micromanagement or aren't comfortable being held to a high standard of integrity, this role isn't for you.



What You'll Do

Shopify & Store Operations

Monitor the Shopify dashboard daily, flag anomalies in orders, inventory, or conversion

Catch and investigate failed orders, payment issues, and edge cases before they escalate

Keep an eye on product listings, discount codes, and promotional setups during peak season



Customer Support Oversight

Act as the point of contact between the founder and our CS team of 3-6 people

Do regular check-ins with the CS team to review ticket volume, response times, and recurring issues

Escalate patterns or systemic issues rather than one-off tickets



Order Resolution

Work alongside the CS team to resolve order problems: missing shipments, returns, address errors, refund decisions

Authorize and process payments to the CS team and resolve payment-related queries

Coordinate with our 3PL/fulfillment partners when needed



Founder Support

Take operational tasks off the founder's plate so he can focus on growth and strategy

Maintain clear async communication, brief daily or weekly updates rather than constant meetings

Flag anything that needs a decision; handle everything that doesn't



You're a Great Fit If You...

Have 3+ years of experience in ecommerce operations, ideally with a DTC brand

Are fluent in Shopify, you know your way around orders, fulfillment, discounts, and customer data

Have managed or coordinated a customer support team before

Work autonomously and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do

Have hands-on experience with Q4 peak season pressure and know how to keep operations tight when volume spikes

Understand international logistics, shipping flows, and stock management across multiple markets

Communicate clearly in writing, async-first, no hand-holding needed

Are available during European business hours (CET/CEST)

Have a bias for action and can make judgment calls without needing approval for everything

Are someone people can genuinely rely on, trust is the foundation of this role, and we build it slowly and lose it fast



Bonus Points

Experience with seasonal / Q4-heavy ecommerce brands

Experience working with international teams or remote-first companies



What We Offer

~20 hours/week, fully remote

Flexible schedule, async-first, outcome-driven

Direct line to the founder, your work has real impact

A brand that's growing fast with room to grow with it



How to Apply

Send a short message through OJ with:

A brief intro, who you are and what you've worked on

One specific example of an operational problem you solved at an ecommerce brand



No cover letter needed. We read every application.



We're a remote-first team.

description:

s

title: Senior Ad Creative — Meta Performance (E-Commerce)
description:
We run paid ads for multiple fast-growing e-commerce brands across health, wellness, lifestyle, and premium consumer products. Our current brand we focus on is -> 
 (Pure copper drink ware -> a lot of benefits (rather than plastic or steel bottles).



We are not a beginner operation.?We are not looking for someone to make pretty pictures.?We are looking for a killer.



You will work directly alongside two experienced performance marketers. 



That means you need to already speak the language — avatars, sub-avatars, micro angles, hooks, ad psychology, visual hierarchy. We will not teach you the basics. We will not explain what a hook is. We will not hold your hand through a brief.



If your portfolio is full of generic dropship creatives — stop here.?If you've never heard of a micro angle — stop here.?If you need someone to tell you what visual to build — stop here.



If you read a hook and immediately see the creative — keep reading.



What You'll Do

* Design high-converting image ads for Meta — single images, carousels, and comparison creatives

* Receive a micro angle, hook, and avatar — and translate that into a visual concept independently with zero hand-holding

* Build creatives with strong visual hierarchy — hook first, proof second, CTA last

* Generate and composite realistic people into scenes using AI — lighting matched, skin tone consistent, indistinguishable from real photography

* Combine product shots, lifestyle imagery, AI-generated visuals, and text overlays into clean conversion-focused creatives

* Edit and enhance product images — compositing, scene-building, background replacement

* Deliver multiple creative variations per angle for split testing

* Iterate based on performance data — not feelings, not aesthetics, not opinions



What We're Looking For

* Strong Photoshop skills — compositing, lighting, retouching, scene-building

* Deep understanding of performance marketing — avatars, sub-avatars, micro angles, hooks, buyer psychology, ad structure

* Proven experience creating image creatives that actually ran on Meta paid traffic and performed

* Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook and a headline that gets ignored

* Advanced AI tooling — not basic prompting. You generate realistic people, match lighting and skin tone, and produce visuals indistinguishable from real photography. You know which tool wins for which job — Midjourney, Firefly, Generative Fill, or equivalent

* Works fast, independently, and delivers consistently

* Already operating at a high level — we will push you further, not build your foundation



What We Offer

* Long-term collaboration with two serious performance marketers

* Consistent creative work with clear direction and structured feedback

* Access to high-level marketing resources and training — but only if you're already good enough to use them

* Competitive compensation based on quality and output
